actions.name: Creep
actions.desc: The anomollusk moves up to its Speed, and can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as it does. Each creature whose space it enters is subjected once to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17. Success: The target is pushed 5 feet away from the anomollusk into a space of its choice. If the target chooses not to move, it suffers the effects of a failure. Failure: The target has the Prone condition and is subjected to Snail Trail.

reactions.name: Shell Reflection
reactions.desc: Trigger: The anomollusk takes damage from a spell or magical attack. Response: The attacker takes Radiant damage equal to the triggering damage and causes an Arcane Anomalies.

sb.name: Apex
sb.senses: Blindsight 20 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 20

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The Apex regains 20 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the Apex takes Necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The Apex dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The Apex's Long Jump is up to 50 feet and its High Jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Apex makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Lightning Bolt
bonus_actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 120-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. Failure: 22 (4d10) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Fire Blast
bonus_actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) Fire damage, and the target and each creature within 10 feet of it is subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target has the Burning condition (4d8 Fire).

bonus_actions.name: Cold Snap
bonus_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature the Apex can see within 120 feet. Failure: 45 (10d8) Cold damage, and the target has the Frozen condition (DC 18). Success: Half damage only.

reactions.name: Rapid Adaptation
reactions.desc: Trigger: The Apex takes damage that isn't Necrotic or Psychic. Response: The Apex gains Immunity to that damage type until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points or finishes a Short or Long Rest.

sb.name: Arcane Wraith
sb.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
sb.languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The arcane wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The arcane wraith makes three Comet Shard attacks.

actions.name: Comet Shard
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) Force damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the arcane wraith.

actions.name: Nightmare Pattern (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cube centered on a point the arcane wraith can see. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition (save ends). While Blinded, the target has the Immobilized condition. The effect ends for the target if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it out of its nightmare. When the effect ends, the target takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The arcane wraith casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]] (the hand is Invisible), [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]]

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 125 (10d10 + 70) plus 125 (10d10 + 70) per player character

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Daywalker
traits.desc: Vladimir von Drakken doesn't possess any Vampire Weaknesses from the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

traits.name: Reborn Transformation
traits.desc: When he finishes a Long Rest, Vladimir von Drakken reverts to his Reborn Vladimir von Drakken form.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If Vladimir von Drakken is reduced to 0 Hit Points or dies, he drops to 1 Hit Point instead unless he is killed by a creature with the blood of House von Drakken within them.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Vladimir von Drakken can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Bloodmourne.** Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 5 ft. Hit: 35 (6d8 + 8) Force damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).
- **Claws.** Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 5 ft. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 23).

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 70 (20d6) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (DC 22 Constitution save ends). Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

actions.name: Soul Rending (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 54 (12d8) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: Double damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 23, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. Failure: 25 (6d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: While Frightened, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from Vladimir von Drakken. Failure: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from Vladimir von Drakken and has the Prone condition. Failure or Success: Before or after using this Epic Action, Vladimir von Drakken can move up to half his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Aerial Maneuver (1/Round)
actions.desc: Vladimir von Drakken moves up to his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

reactions.name: Blood Rage (1/Day)
reactions.desc: Trigger: Vladimir von Drakken becomes Bloodied. He can use this Reaction even if he has the Incapacitated condition or is otherwise unable to take Reactions. Response: All conditions and spells on Vladimir von Drakken end unless he chooses to be affected by them, and he can move up to his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action and ignoring Difficult Terrain. Vladimir von Drakken recharges and immediately uses Soul Rending.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The beetle knight makes two Scything Arm-Blade attacks.

actions.name: Scything Arm-Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Pincer Horn
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage, or 26 (4d10 + 4) Piercing damage if the beetle knight moved 20+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the beetle knight can't use its Pincer Horn against another target.

bonus_actions.name: Fling
bonus_actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature Grappled by the beetle knight. Failure: The target is thrown up to 1d6 × 10 feet, landing with the Prone condition. If the target strikes a solid surface, it takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Carapace Parry
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the beetle knight can see hits it with an attack. Response: The beetle knight adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The belfray doesn't provoke Opportunity Attack action when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.desc: The belfray has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The belfray makes two Claws attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace its Bite with Sonic Blast, if available.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Enfeebled condition until the end of the belfray's next turn. The belfray regains Hit Points equal to the damage dealt by its Bite.

actions.name: Sonic Blast (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the belfray that can hear it. Failure: 22 (4d8 + 4) Thunder damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonus_actions.desc: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the belfray takes the Hide action.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If Big Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: When Big Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 10 Hit Points. Big Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Big Linda makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and Big Linda can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Spew (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 63 (14d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 74 (4d20 + 32) plus 74 (4d20 + 32) per player character

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If Bigger Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: When Bigger Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 20 Hit Points. Bigger Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Bigger Linda is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: The target gains a Contamination level. Failure or Success: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: Bigger Linda deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: Bigger Linda has Immunity to any spell or effect that would alter her form.

actions.name: Bigger Linda always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On her turn, Bigger Linda can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Bigger Linda takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Bite.** Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 10 ft. Hit: 35 (4d12 + 9) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 23). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and Bigger Linda can't Bite another target.
- **Tail.** Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 20 feet away from Bigger Linda and has the Prone condition.
- **Stomp.** Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 5 ft. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) Bludgeoning damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23. Failure: The target has the Staggered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Breathe Deep
actions.desc: Bigger Linda's Breath Weapon recharges. Bigger Linda can only take this Epic Action as the first Epic Action she uses this round. After using this Epic Action, Bigger Linda can't take her Bite Epic Action until the start of the next round.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 22, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. Failure: 31 (7d8) Necrotic damage plus 31 (7d8) Force damage, and the target gains a Contamination level. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Trampling Rampage (Recharges When Bloodied)
actions.desc: Bigger Linda moves up to her Speed in a straight line, moving through the space of Large or smaller creatures in her path. She makes one Stomp attack against each creature she moves through.

actions.name: Teleport (1/Round)
actions.desc: Bigger Linger teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see within the Deep Haze.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: Bigger Linda chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. Bigger Linda can use this Epic Action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Blackjack Mel is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if he fails, provided he doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Knife
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: Blackjack Mel takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature Blackjack Mel can see deals damage to him with an attack. Response: Blackjack Mel halves the damage he takes from that attack.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The dreg can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 5 (2d4) Acid damage and is Burning (2d4 Acid).

traits.name: Insect Swarm
traits.desc: The bloated hive emits a 10-foot Emanation of buzzing insects. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Disrupt the Hive
traits.desc: When the bloated hive dies, it immediately spawns a Swarm of Contaminated Insects in its space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Bloated Hive makes two attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Spawn Swarm (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The bloated hive creates a Swarm of Contaminated Insects, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. The swarm takes its turn immediately after the bloated hive.

bonus_actions.name: Distracting Swarm
bonus_actions.desc: The bloated hive causes its Insect Swarm to fly in the face of a creature within 5 feet of it. The target can't take Reactions until the end of the bloated hive's turn.

sb.name: Blood Leech
sb.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Aquatic Camouflage
traits.desc: The leech has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

traits.name: Blood Bags
traits.desc: The leech has three blood bags in its body. When encountered, roll 1d3 to determine how many blood bags are filled with blood. The rest are empty.

actions.name: Attach
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 0 ft. Hit: The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure: The leech is still detached, but the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Blood Drain
bonus_actions.desc: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature. The attached creature loses 10 (3d6) Hit Points due to blood loss, and the blood leech fills one of its empty blood bags with some of the target's blood.

bonus_actions.name: Blood Transfusion
bonus_actions.desc: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled blood bag. The attached creature regains 10 3d6 Hit Points, and the leech empties one of its filled blood bags.

sb.name: Body Snatcher
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Clinging Shadows
traits.desc: A creature in Dim Light or Darkness has Disadvantage on ability checks to escape the body snatcher's grapple. Each time a creature attempts to escape the body snatcher's grapple while it is in Dim Light or Darkness, the creature takes 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage. If this Necrotic damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target is stabilized but has the Paralyzed condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.desc: The body snatcher takes 10 (3d6) Radiant damage if it ends its turn in sunlight, and has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks while in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The body snatcher makes four Grabbing Hands attacks.

actions.name: Grabbing Hands
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the body snatcher can't use this hand against another target. The body snatcher has four hands, each of which can grapple one target.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Teleport
bonus_actions.desc: The body snatcher teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see that is in Dim Light or Darkness. It can bring any Medium or smaller creature it is grappling, teleporting that creature to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of its destination that is also in Dim Light or Darkness. An unwilling creature can make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw to resist being teleported. On a successful save, neither the creature nor the body snatcher [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|Teleport]].

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The bojack can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the bojack remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal animal corpse.

traits.name: Sudden Death
traits.desc: Creatures that haven't yet taken a turn in combat are Helpless against attacks made by the bojack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bojack makes two attacks, using Impaling Limbs or Corrosive Mucus in any combination.

actions.name: Impaling Limbs
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage and the target is Bleeding (2d6). While Bleeding in this way, the target is also Slowed.

actions.name: Corrosive Mucus
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) Acid damage and the target is Burning (2d4 Acid). While Burning in this way, the target's AC becomes 10 + its Dexterity modifier.

bonus_actions.name: Predatory Cunning
bonus_actions.desc: The bojack takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 54 (4d12 + 28) plus 54 (4d12 + 28) per player character

traits.name: Cacophonous Chorus
traits.desc: The cacophonous chimera creates a 30-foot Emanation of noise. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation that can hear it takes 10 (3d6) Thunder damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.desc: The cacophonous chimera has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: The cacophonous chimera always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On its turn, the cacophonous chimera can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the cacophonous chimera takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Claws and Talons.** Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (1d10 + 6) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Prone condition.
- **Contaminated Bite (1/Round).** Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target gains a Contamination level.

actions.name: Lamprey Tail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll:+11, reach 30 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Piercing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4).

actions.name: Aerial Maneuver (1/Round)
actions.desc: The cacophonous chimera flies up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Cacophony (1/Round)
actions.desc: The cacophonous chimera's three heads sing a discordant song. The effect of the song varies based on which of the chimera's head is taking the lead. Each time the cacophonous chimera uses this Epic Action, it can't use the same effect it chose last round.

actions.name: Bewildering Chitter (Ratling)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the chimera that can hear it. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Bewildered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Chilling Howl (Garmyr)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the cacophonous chimera that can hear it. Failure: 10 (3d6) Cold damage, and the target has the Immobilized condition (save ends).

actions.name: Staggering Screech (Harpy)
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the cacophonous chimera that can hear it. Failure: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Staggered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Wing Blast
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature within 15 feet of the cacophonous chimera. Failure: 13 (2d6 + 6) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the chimera. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The cacophonous chimera chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The cacophonous chimera can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

reactions.name: Crescendo of Chaos (1/Day)
reactions.desc: Trigger: The cacophonous chimera becomes Bloodied. It can take this Reaction even if it has the Incapacitated condition or is otherwise unable to take Reactions. Response: All conditions and spells on the cacophonous chimera immediately end unless it chooses to be affected by them, and it can move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action and ignoring Difficult Terrain. It then unleashes a blast of thunderous power. Creatures within 300 feet of it who can hear it are subjected to the following effect. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 17 (5d6) Thunder damage plus 17 (5d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Prone condition and can't stand until the end of its next turn.

sb.name: Captain Ansom Lang
sb.gear: Longbow, Quiver, Shortsword, Studded Leather Armor

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: If Ansom is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails, provided he doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ansom makes four attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of Ansom's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Flurry of Blades
bonus_actions.desc: Ansom makes two Shortsword attacks.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature Ansom can see hits him with an attack. Response: Ansom adds 3 to his AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss.

sb.name: Cerebrograft
sb.languages: telepathy 30 ft. The languages of its creator

traits.name: Dual Minds
traits.desc: The cerebrograft has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious conditions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cerebrograft makes two Slam attacks and uses Telekinetic Grip.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Telekinetic Grip
actions.desc: The cerebrograft reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the Restrained condition until the start of the cerebrograft's next turn or until the cerebrograft has the Incapacitated condition. If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The cerebrograft can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

actions.name: Psychic Crush (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the cerebrograft. Failure: 22 (4d10) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: The target instead has the Stunned condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Critical Condition
traits.desc: A creature that rolls a natural 1 on a saving throw against the chemist's attacks or effects takes maximum damage from the attack or effect.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: Chemist is immune to the Burning condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The chemist makes one Caustic Grip attack and uses either Chemical Spray or Explosive Concoction, if available.

actions.name: Caustic Grip
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 24 (8d4 + 4) Acid damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and the chemist can't use Caustic Grip against another target. At the end of each of its turns, the target takes 24 (8d4 + 4) Acid damage.

actions.name: Chemical Spray
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 28 (8d6) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice). Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Explosive Concoction (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of the chemist. Failure: 45 (10d8) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice), and the target has the Burning condition (4d6, same damage type). Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Acid Rain (1/Day)
actions.desc: The chemist conjures a storm of acid rain in a 20-foot radius, 20-foot tall Cylinder centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. Exposed flames in the area are doused. Chemical pools accumulate in the area and emit thick fumes, rendering it Difficult Terrain and Lightly Obscured. The storm and the pools evaporate after 1 minute. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 30 (12d4) Acid damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Emergency Dose
bonus_actions.desc: The chemist administers a restorative poultice to itself or a creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target regains 35 10d6 Hit Points. Once a creature benefits from Emergency Dose, it can't do so again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

sb.name: Chemystral
sb.damage_resistances: acid, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous Form
traits.desc: The chemystral can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Cold Vulnerability
traits.desc: If the chemystral takes Cold damage, it becomes Frozen (DC 15). While it has the Frozen condition, it loses its Immunities to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and its Resistance to Force damage, and it gains Vulnerability to Thunder damage. In addition to the normal means, the Frozen condition ends if the chemystral takes 20 points of Force, Piercing, Thunder, or Slashing damage.

traits.name: Elemental Reaction
traits.desc: If the Chemystral takes Acid, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Necrotic damage, it takes on elemental properties which change the damage type of its Chemical Spray and Engulf actions to match that damage type. In addition, it causes an additional effect when it hits with its Chemical Spray attack:

traits.name: Acid
traits.desc: On a hit, the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Acid).

traits.name: Fire
traits.desc: On a hit, the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire).

traits.name: Lightning
traits.desc: On a hit, the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Poison
traits.desc: On a hit, the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Necrotic
traits.desc: On a hit, the chemystral regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The chemystral regains 25 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the chemystral takes Cold or Thunder damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The chemystral dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sonic Neutralization
traits.desc: When the chemystral takes Thunder damage, it loses any active benefit from its Elemental Reaction trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The chemystral makes two Chemical Spray attacks and uses Engulf.

actions.name: Chemical Spray
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 35 (10d6) Acid damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc: The chemystral moves up to its Speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the chemystral enters a creature's space, the creature is subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Success: The creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the chemystral. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw. Failure: The chemystral enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 35 (10d6) Acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, has the Restrained condition, and takes 35 (10d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the chemystral's turns. The engulfed creature has Total Cover from effects outside the chemystral. When the chemystral moves, the engulfed creature moves with it. The chemystral can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful DC 17 Strength check, entering a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

traits.name: No Escape
traits.desc: When the dreg hits a creature with an Opportunity Attack action, that creature's Speed becomes 0 until the end of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dreg makes two Bone Blade attacks.

actions.name: Bone Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Force damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against any creature other than the dreg until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Sentinel Strike
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature within 5 feet of the dreg takes the Disengage action or makes a melee attack roll against a target other than the dreg. Response: The dreg makes an Opportunity Attack action against that creature.

sb.name: Chitter
sb.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.desc: As long as the chitter has moved 20+ feet this turn, it has a high jump and long jump of 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The chitter makes two Sharpened Claws attacks and one Acrid Bite attack. It can also use Chitter, if available.

actions.name: Acrid Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Sharpened Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Chitter (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature within 120 feet of the chitter that can hear it. Failure: The target has the Dazed condition until the end of the chitter's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Aggressive
bonus_actions.desc: The chitter moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile creature it can see. If it ends this movement adjacent to the creature, it gains Advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the end of its turn.

reactions.name: Slow Fall
reactions.desc: Trigger: The chitter takes falling damage and doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. Response: The triggering damage is reduced to 0.

sb.name: Chorus
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through an opening large enough for a Small creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The swarm makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) Psychic damage.

sb.name: Congregation
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Dispersal
traits.desc: When the congregation is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it leaves behind 2d4 Pilgrims in its place.

traits.name: Mob
traits.desc: The congregation can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the congregation can move through any opening large enough for a Medium Humanoid. The congregation can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The congregation makes one attack against each creature in its space.

actions.name: Torches
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 0 ft. Hit: The target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire).

actions.name: Pitchforks
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 0 ft. Hit: 28 (8d6) Piercing damage, or 14 (4d6) Piercing damage if the congregation has the Bloodied condition. The target has the Prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Trample
bonus_actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature in the congregation's space that has the Prone condition. Failure: 17 (2d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.

sb.name: Crater Wurm
sb.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 9

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.desc: The crater wurm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrowing Speed and leaves a 10-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The crater wurm makes a Bite attack, then makes Bite attacks against each creature adjacent to the first target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 35 (4d12 + 9) Piercing damage, and if it is Large or smaller, the target is subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 22. Failure: The target is swallowed by the wurm. The target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against effects originating from outside the wurm, and takes 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the wurm's turns. A creature that takes this Necrotic damage must also succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or gain one Contamination level. If the wurm takes 30+ damage on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in spaces within 10 feet of the wurm with the Prone condition. If the wurm dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Breach
actions.desc: The wurm moves up to its Speed, entering the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters is subjected once to the following effect. At the end of its movement, the wurm can make one Bite attack against a Prone creature as a Bonus Action. Strength Saving Throw: DC 22. Success: The target is pushed 5 feet away from the wurm into a space of its choice. If the target chooses not to move, it suffers the effects of a failure. Failure: 35 (10d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the wurm and has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 39 (6d8 + 12) plus 39 (6d8 + 12) per player character

traits.name: Aura of Storms
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Crimson Countess takes 10 (3d6) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Pluck
traits.desc: The Crimson Countess doesn't need to spend extra movement to drag a Medium or smaller creature Grappled by it.

actions.name: The Crimson Countess always takes their turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On their turn, the Crimson Countess can use their movement and interaction as normal. However, they do not take an action or Bonus Action on their turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Crimson Countess takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Grasping Talons.** Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).
- **Lightning Javelin.** Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Aerial Acrobat
actions.desc: The Crimson Countess flies up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Frightful Screech (1/Round)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 120 feet of the Crimson Countess that can hear them. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). While Frightened, the target must take the Dash action and move away from the Crimson Countess by the safest available route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move.

actions.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creatures in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. Failure: 36 (8d8) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The Crimson Countess chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on them. The Crimson Countess can use this action even if they would otherwise be unable to take actions, their actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters their game statistics.

sb.name: Crimson Knight
sb.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness), passive Perception 12

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Crimson Axe
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/90 ft. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 4) Force damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of the vampire's choice. Hit or Miss: After being thrown, the axe returns to the vampire's hand.

actions.name: Crackling Smite
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 10 (3d6) Thunder damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Unholy Smite
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the end of the vampire's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Wrathful Smite
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 14 (3d6 + 4) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonus_actions.name: Charge
bonus_actions.desc: The vampire moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile creature it can see. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of the creature, it has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes against that creature before the end of its turn.

reactions.name: Unbridled Fury
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature hits the vampire with an attack. Response: The vampire makes a Crimson Axe attack against the attacker.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 76 (9d8 + 36) plus 76 (9d8 + 36) per player character

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Reborn Transformation
traits.desc: When Vladimir von Drakken consumes the blood of six living creatures of level or challenge rating 10 or higher, he transforms into Reborn Vladimir von Drakken. His Initiative doesn't change. If he is destroyed before he can feed sufficiently, he must begin the process again when he rejuvenates.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If Vladimir von Drakken is destroyed in his crypt-starved form, he crumbles into ash and reforms 1d10 days later with all of his Hit Points. His new body appears within his crypt in the Brachenwald. Casting Hallow on the druidic shrine prevents his new body from returning so long as the spell remains in effect.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Bloodmourne.** Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 26 (6d6 + 5) Force damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).
- **Claws.** Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 40 (10d6 + 5) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point Maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to that amount. A Humanoid killed by this effect and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. Failure: 21 (6d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: While Frightened, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Shadow Step (1/Round)
actions.desc: Vladimir von Drakken teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet that is in Dim Light or Darkness. He has Advantage on the next melee attack he makes before the end of this round.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dreg makes two Refracted Beam attacks.

actions.name: Refracted Beam
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the dreg's next turn. If this attack deals a different damage type due to Refract Elements, it has additional effects:

actions.name: Acid or Fire
actions.desc: The target is also Burning (2d6) of the corresponding damage type.

actions.name: Cold
actions.desc: The target has the Frozen Condition (DC 13).

actions.name: Lightning
actions.desc: The target has the Shocked Condition until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Refract Elements
reactions.desc: Trigger: The dreg takes Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage. Response: The dreg gains Resistance to the triggering damage type, including the triggering damage, until the end of its next turn. During its next turn, its Refracted Beam attack deals damage of that damage type instead of Radiant damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hulk makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with its Eye Laser.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Eye Laser
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 18 (4d8) Force damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: If the target is a creature and this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into a pile of fine delerium dust.

bonus_actions.name: Wink (Recharge 4–6)
bonus_actions.desc: The hulk vanishes from the Material Plane and is transported to the Space Between Worlds. At the start of its next turn, it returns to an unoccupied space of its choice within 10 feet of the space it vanished from. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, it appears in the nearest unoccupied space (chosen at random if more than one space is equally near).

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite, Unholy Light, or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Spiritual Maul
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Force damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the vampire.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 12 (3d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Unholy Light (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 10-foot radius, 40-foot high Cylinder centered on a point the vampire can see within 120 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage, and the target has the Staggered condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The vampire casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|Guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bane|Bane]], [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|Darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|Disguise Self]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Spirit Guardians|Spirit Guardians]]

reactions.name: Blood Rebuke
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the vampire can see within 60 feet of it deals damage to it. Response—Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4). Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The dark growth can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The dark growth regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the Dark Growth takes Fire or Radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the dark growth's next turn. The dark growth dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dark growth makes three attacks: two with its Entangling Vines and one with its Infection Spores.

actions.name: Entangling Vines
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 30 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) and the target has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Infection Spores
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 60 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is infected with a disease called Dark Decay. Instead of acting normally on its turn, the target must move toward the closest creature that isn't infected with Dark Decay and make one melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the target of that attack must also make a saving throw against Dark Decay. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save. Subsequent Failures: The target gains one Contamination level. Third Success: The disease ends. An infected creature that dies or undergoes a Monstrous Transformation becomes a Dark Growth Shambler. A [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|Lesser Restoration]] spell or similar magic that removes diseases ends Dark Decay, as does any magic that removes Contamination levels.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dark growth shambler makes two Claw attacks and one Infectious Bite attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Infectious Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is infected with a disease called Dark Decay. Instead of acting normally on its turn, the target must move toward the closest creature that isn't infected with Dark Decay and make one melee attack against it. If the attack hits, the target of that attack must also make a saving throw against Dark Decay. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save. Subsequent Failures: The target gains one Contamination level. Third Success: The disease ends. An infected creature that dies or undergoes a Monstrous Transformation becomes a Dark Growth Shambler. A [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|Lesser Restoration]] spell or similar magic that removes diseases ends Dark Decay, as does any magic that removes Contamination levels.

reactions.name: Abrupt Decay
reactions.desc: Trigger: The dark growth shambler drops to 0 Hit Points and it hasn't taken Fire damage this round. Response: The dark growth shambler creates a Dark Growth in its space.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The deep dreg can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Watery Camouflage
traits.desc: The deep dreg has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to Hide in any area Lightly Obscured by murky water or aquatic features.

traits.name: Catch of the Day (1/Turn)
traits.desc: The deep dreg can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a Prone or Restrained creature it hits with a weapon attack.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage if wielded with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Net
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +3 to hit, range 5/15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: The target has the Restrained condition. A creature can take an action to free itself or another creature in a net with a successful DC 10 Strength check. Dealing 5 Slashing damage to the net (AC 10) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

traits.name: Abyssal Aura
traits.desc: Allies within 30 feet who can see and hear the deep knight have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed and Frightened conditions. The deep knight can't use this trait if it is Incapacitated.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The deep knight can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Unwavering Sentinel
traits.desc: Creatures provoke Opportunity Attack action from the deep knight even if they take the Disengage action before leaving its reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deep knight makes one Harpoon attack and one Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target is pulled up to 20 feet toward the deep knight.

bonus_actions.name: Shield Bash
bonus_actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The deep siren can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deep siren makes two Storm Lash attacks.

actions.name: Storm Lash
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the deep siren.

actions.name: Discordant Song (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature of the deep siren's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the deep siren. Failure: 21 (6d6) Psychic damage, and the target must roll 1d6 and subtract the result from each D20 Test it makes. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. It automatically succeeds after 1 minute.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.desc: The deep siren covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and shape. The illusion ends if the siren takes a Bonus Action to end it or if she dies. The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the siren could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching them would feel their fishy flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the siren is disguised.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The deep siren casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to spell attacks):

- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Fog Cloud|Fog Cloud]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|Lightning Bolt]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Elemental|Conjure Elemental]] (water only), [[Tools/Spells/Control Water|Control Water]]

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step
bonus_actions.desc: The deep siren magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

sb.name: Delerium Dragon Wyrmling
sb.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The dragon is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The dragon may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.desc: As an action, the dragon can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the dragon has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.desc: The dragon is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the dragon's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes one Bite attack and uses Contaminated Rend twice.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Force damage.

actions.name: Contaminated Rend
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet of the dragon. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Octarine Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage plus 10 (3d6) Psychic damage plus 10 (3d6) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

bonus_actions.name: Dimension Hop
bonus_actions.desc: The dragon teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

traits.name: Misty Camouflage
traits.desc: A dreg has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when taking the Hide action in any area obscured by mist or fog, including the Haze.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Critical Hit: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target gains one level of Contamination.

sb.name: Digipede
sb.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 13

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The digipede makes one Bite attack and two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Lightning damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target has the Shocked condition until the end of the digipede's next turn.

actions.name: Eye Beam (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. Failure: 35 (10d6) Lightning damage, and the target has the Slowed condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Immobilized condition. Third Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition. Success: Half damage only.

sb.name: Disembodied Psyche
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The psyche can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The psyche makes two Electroshock attacks. It can also use Hypnotize, if available.

actions.name: Electroshock
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 35 (10d6) Lightning damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target has the Dazed condition until the end of the psyche's next turn.

actions.name: Hypnotize (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature of the psyche's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the psyche. Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). While Incapacitated, the target has the Immobilized condition.

actions.name: Mental Possession
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the psyche can see within 5 feet. Success: The target is immune to this psyche's Mental Possession for 24 hours. Failure: The target is possessed by the psyche; the psyche disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The psyche now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The psyche can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The psyche's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the psyche leaves as a Bonus Action. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the possession on a success. When the possession ends, the psyche appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this psyche's Mental Possession for 24 hours.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport
bonus_actions.desc: The psyche teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet.

traits.name: Displacement
traits.desc: Attack rolls against the dreg have Disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack roll, this trait does not apply until the end of its next turn. This trait does not apply while the dreg has the Incapacitated condition or has a Speed of 0.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport (Recharge 4–6)
bonus_actions.desc: The dreg teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dreg can make one melee attack. If this attack hits, it deals an extra 10 (3d6) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: Dr. Everett Freed, Reanimator is immune to the Weakened condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Reanimator makes two Electric Jolt or Necrotic Blast attacks.

actions.name: Electric Jolt
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 35 (10d6) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the end of the Reanimator's next turn.

actions.name: Necrotic Blast
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition until the end of the Reanimator's next turn.

actions.name: Touch of Death (1/Day)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 200 Poison damage. This damage ignores [[Tools/Spells/Resistance|Resistance]] and Immunity to Poison damage and can't be reduced or prevented in any way. If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it automatically fails death saving throws until it finishes a Long Rest. A Heal or [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|Greater Restoration]] spell ends this effect early.

actions.name: Reanimate (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The Reanimator targets the corpse of one of its destroyed creations it can see within 30 feet. The target returns to life with 45 (10d8) Hit Points. The target has Resistance to all damage and Advantage on saving throws until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The Reanimator casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/False Life|False Life]], [[Tools/Spells/Gentle Repose|Gentle Repose]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Animate Dead|Animate Dead]], [[Tools/Spells/Death Ward|Death Ward]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|Hold Person]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|Lightning Bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|Raise Dead]]

bonus_actions.name: Creator's Command
bonus_actions.desc: The Reanimator chooses a creature it can see that was reanimated or created by it. The target can use its Reaction to make an attack with Advantage or move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

reactions.name: Bodyguard
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the Reanimator can see targets it with an attack or spell that targets only the reanimator. Response: The Reanimator chooses one of its creations within 10 feet and switches spaces with it. The creation becomes the target instead.

traits.name: Contaminated Regeneration
traits.desc: The sewer gator regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn as long as it is in contaminated water. The gator dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Amphibious Lunge
traits.desc: If the sewer gator swims 20+ feet on its turn, it can long jump or high jump up to 60 feet. If it ends this jump within 5 feet of a creature, it has Advantage on its next Crushing Bite attack against that creature, and that attack deals an additional 40 (9d8) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Predatory Stealth
traits.desc: The sewer gator has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to Hide in water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sewer gator makes two attacks. It can't make both a Crushing Bite attack and a Tail Strike attack against the same target.

actions.name: Crushing Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 15 ft. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the sewer gator can't use Crushing Bite against another target.

actions.name: Tail Strike
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 15 ft. Hit: 25 (4d6 + 7) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the sewer gator and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Death Roll
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 15 ft., one creature Grappled by the sewer gator. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) Piercing damage. Strength Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The target has the Dazed and Helpless conditions until it escapes the sewer gator's grapple.

reactions.name: Submerge
reactions.desc: Trigger: The sewer gator takes damage while in water. Response: The sewer gator swims half its speed and takes the Hide action.

traits.name: Blood Sacrifice
traits.desc: A creature with the Restrained condition also has the Helpless condition against the vampire's attacks.

traits.name: Plasma Absorption
traits.desc: Each time a creature takes damage from the Bleeding condition while within 30 feet of the vampire, the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Draining Bite or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Bloodthorn Whip
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 30 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 5) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

actions.name: Draining Bite
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 14 (3d6 + 4) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Bloodroots (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the vampire. Failure: 21 (6d6) Piercing damage, and the target has the Restrained condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The vampire casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|Druidcraft]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Beast|Dominate Beast]], [[Tools/Spells/Entangle|Entangle]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|Faerie Fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|Pass Without Trace]], [[Tools/Spells/Spike Growth|Spike Growth]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Antilife Shell|Antilife Shell]], [[Tools/Spells/Contagion|Contagion]], [[Tools/Spells/Create Undead|Create Undead]] (as an action), [[Tools/Spells/Insect Plague|Insect Plague]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Suggestion|Mass Suggestion]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]]

sb.name: Effulgent Cnidarian
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Altered Reality
traits.desc: The cnidarian has the Invisible condition for creatures Charmed by it.

traits.name: Hallucinogenic Bioluminescence
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the cnidarian and can see it is subjected to the following effect unless the cnidarian chooses otherwise. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition (save ends). While Charmed, the target regards all other creatures as enemies except the cnidarian, whom it regards as an ally. Whenever the target makes an attack or casts a detrimental spell, it must choose its target at random from the creatures it can see within range. If a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack action from the target, it must make the attack, if able. If the target ends its turn without taking an Attack or Magic action, it takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against the cnidarian until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the cnidarian in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

traits.name: Neon Illumination
traits.desc: The cnidarian sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cnidarian makes two Tendrils attacks.

actions.name: Tendrils
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 27 (6d8) Necrotic damage, or 48 Necrotic damage if the target is Charmed by the cnidarian.

reactions.name: Reflexive Flash
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the cnidarian can see within 30 feet deals damage to it. Response—Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the cnidarian that can see it. Failure: 10 (3d6) Radiant damage and the target has the Blinded condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.

sb.name: Eldrick Runeweaver
sb.gear: Robe Of The Archmagi, Staff Of Power

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 75 (10d8 + 30) plus 75 (10d8 + 30) per player character

traits.name: Academy Rings (1/Day)
traits.desc: Eldrick can cast a spell from Spellcasting without expending a use of it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Eldrick has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Warding Aura
traits.desc: Eldrick projects a 30-foot Emanation of warding magic. The first time on each turn that a creature within the Emanation deals damage or casts a spell on Eldrick, that creature takes 14 (4d6) Force damage and is pushed 10 feet away from Eldrick.

actions.name: Eldrick always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On his turn, Eldrick can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Eldrick takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Prismatic Blast
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +15, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 6) Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (Eldrick's choice).

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: Eldrick teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet.

actions.name: Chain Lightning (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Eldrick casts [[Tools/Spells/Chain Lightning|Chain Lightning]], using the spellcasting ability in Spellcasting.

actions.name: Dispel Magic (1/Round)
actions.desc: Eldrick casts [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], using the spellcasting ability in Spellcasting.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: Eldrick chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. Eldrick can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

actions.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
actions.desc:
Eldrick casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21, +13 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included above), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bigby'S Hand|Bigby's Hand]] (Eldrick may use an Epic Action to control the hand once per round), [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|Banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|Dimension Door]], [[Tools/Spells/Ice Storm|Ice Storm]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|Lightning Bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|Wall of Force]]

actions.name: Greater Spellcasting (1/Round)
actions.desc:
Eldrick casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21, +13 to spell attacks):

- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Forcecage|Forcecage]], [[Tools/Spells/Globe Of Invulnerability|Globe of Invulnerability]], [[Tools/Spells/Maze|Maze]], [[Tools/Spells/Prismatic Spray|Prismatic Spray]], [[Tools/Spells/Prismatic Wall|Prismatic Wall]], [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|Teleport]]

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.desc: Eldrick casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] in response to that spell's trigger, using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

sb.name: Eldritch Cataclysm
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Air Form
traits.desc: The eldritch cataclysm can enter a Hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Cyclonic Storm
traits.desc: The eldritch cataclysm emits a 120-foot Emanation of high winds that disperse gases and vapors and extinguish unprotected flames.
