Ranged attacks that pass through the area have Disadvantage. Objects that are not worn or carried are blown away 1d6 x 5 feet in a random direction. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17 (flying creatures have Disadvantage). Failure: The target has the Slowed condition until the start of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target is flung 1d6 x 5 feet in a random direction, landing with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The eldritch cataclysm uses Chain Lighting or Icy Bolt, then uses Meteor Stike or Quake.

actions.name: Chain Lightning
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 7) Lightning damage, the target has the Shocked condition until the end of the cataclysm's next turn, and the lightning leaps to another creature of the cataclysm's choice within 15 feet of the first target. The cataclysm makes a separate [[Tools/Spells/Chain Lightning|Chain Lightning]] attack against the target. The cataclysm can make any number of [[Tools/Spells/Chain Lightning|Chain Lightning]] attacks in this way, but a creature can be targeted only once each time the cataclysm takes this action.

actions.name: Icy Bolt
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 7) Cold damage. Hit or Miss: The target and each creature within 5 feet of it are subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage, and the target has the Frozen condition (DC 17).

actions.name: Meteor Strike
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 15-foot radius, 40-foot tall Cylinder centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 120 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Fire damage plus 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Quake
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the cataclysm. Failure: 28 (8d6) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The eldritch crawler is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The eldritch crawler may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.desc: As an action, the eldritch crawler can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the eldritch crawler has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.desc: The eldritch crawler is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the eldritch crawler's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Insectoid Limbs
traits.desc: The eldritch crawler can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. It ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one target within 5 ft. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Contaminated Venom
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one target within 40 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Void Walker
bonus_actions.desc: The eldritch crawler climbs through a tear in reality, traveling from the Material Plane to the Space Between Worlds or vice versa.

reactions.name: Fractured Reality
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature misses the eldritch crawler with an attack. Response: The eldritch crawler teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet, briefly leaving behind a fractured image of itself being hit by the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dreg makes two Psychic Blast attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Blast
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) Psychic damage and the dreg pushes the target 10 feet straight away from itself.

actions.name: Synaptic Shock (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The dreg unleashes a storm of psychic energy in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 60 feet of it. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw or take 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and has the Dazed condition (save ends).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The dreg casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included in AC), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|Levitate]] (self only)

bonus_actions.name: Hazewarp Hex
bonus_actions.desc: The dreg chooses a creature it can see within 60 feet of it and one of the following conditions: Addled, Clumsy, Enfeebled, or Sickened. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, the targeted creature. Failure: The target becomes cursed by the dreg for one minute or until the dreg dies or uses this ability again. While cursed in this manner, a creature becomes vulnerable to Psychic damage and gains the chosen condition (sane ends). Success: The target is immune to the dreg's Hazewarp Hex for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The trickster makes two Psychic Blade attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Blade
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The trickster casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included above), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|Disguise Self]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|Major image]], [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|Mirror Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Sleep|Sleep]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|Suggestion]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|Dominate Person]], [[Tools/Spells/Gaseous Form|Gaseous Form]], [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|Hypnotic Pattern]]

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: The trickster takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Force or Psychic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll makes two Claw attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace its Bite attack with Corrupting Blast if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Corrupting Blast (Recharge 5–6)

bonus_actions.name: Grotesque Wings
bonus_actions.desc: The troll gains a Fly Speed equal to is Speed, but it falls if it ends its turn in the air.

bonus_actions.name: Cyclopean Eye
bonus_actions.desc: Corrupting Blast now recharges on a 4-6, and the troll gains Truesight 30 ft.

bonus_actions.name: Extra Arms
bonus_actions.desc: The troll can make two additional Claw attacks as part of the Multiattack action.

bonus_actions.name: Spider Legs
bonus_actions.desc: The troll gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed and can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

bonus_actions.name: Reflective Flesh
bonus_actions.desc: The troll has the Invisible condition until it makes an attack.

bonus_actions.name: Crystalized Carapace
bonus_actions.desc: The troll's Armor Class becomes 20.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.desc: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Enduring Flame
traits.desc: Flames within 10 feet of the elemental can't be extinguished, and the Burning condition can't end for creatures within 10 feet of the elemental.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.desc: The elemental sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light in an additional 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack

bonus_actions.name: Flickerjump

sb.languages: telepathy 120 ft. Understand all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 73 (7d10 + 35) plus 73 (7d10 + 35) per player character

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The entropic watcher is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The entropic watcher may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.desc: As an action, the entropic watcher can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the entropic watcher has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.desc: The entropic watcher is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the entropic watcher's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Corrupting Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the entropic watcher takes 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The entropic watcher has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Withering Gaze
traits.desc: The entropic watcher's eye creates a 150-foot long, 10-foot wide Line of withering magic. At the start of each of its turns, the entropic watcher decides which way the line faces and whether the line is active. Creatures in the Line have Vulnerability to Necrotic damage and can't regain Hit Points.

actions.name: The entropic watcher always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On its turn, the entropic watcher can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the entropic watcher takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Tendrils.** Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 40 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The entropic watcher has ten tendrils, each of which can grapple one creature.
- **Insanity Beam (1/Round).** Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 60 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage, and the beam leaps to another target. The entropic watcher makes another Insanity Beam attack against a new target within 30 feet of the first. A creature can be targeted by only one Insanity Beam per turn. For each additional creature the beam hits, its damage increases by 5 (1d10).

actions.name: Dimensional Glide
actions.desc: The entropic watcher moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Shadow Crash (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot radius Sphere centered on a point the entropic watcher can see within 150 feet. Failure: 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The Sphere's area is filled with magical Darkness for 1 minute or until the entropic watcher uses Shadow Crash again. A creature that ends its turn in the area takes 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Contaminated Grasp
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature Grappled by the entropic watcher. Failure: 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Force Barrier

The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the entropic watcher has the Incapacitated condition or dies. The wall appears in any orientation it chooses, and can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the entropic watcher's choice). Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]]. A [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|Disintegrate]] spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel through the wall.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The entropic watcher chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The entropic watcher can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.desc: The lepidoptera can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature is moved 20 feet in a random direction.

traits.name: Incomprehensible Vision
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the lepidoptera and can see it is subjected to the following effect. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The target has the Staggered condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is transported to the Border Ethereal. If the target is already on the Border Ethereal, they are transported to the Material Plane instead. Unless surprised, a creature can avert their eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of their turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the lepidoptera until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the lepidoptera in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

traits.name: Multidimensional Presence
traits.desc: If the lepidoptera is reduced to 0 Hit Points but hasn't taken damage from a source on both the Material Plane and the Border Ethereal in the last round, it drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

traits.name: Phototaxis
traits.desc: If a source of Bright Light is within 100 feet of the lepidoptera, it attempts to move closer to the light on its turn.

traits.name: Unraveling Reality
traits.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the lepidoptera when it dies. Success: The target is transported from the Material Plane to the Border Ethereal, or vice versa.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lepidoptera makes two Fractal Wing attacks.

actions.name: Fractal Wing
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 35 (5d10 + 7) Force damage.

actions.name: Tessellation (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the lepidoptera that doesn't have Total Cover. Failure: 44 (8d10) Force damage, and the target begins its next turn by moving up to its Speed in a random direction. If the target has the Staggered condition, it instead takes no damage, that condition ends, and the target has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). While Incapacitated, the target mutters rhymes in a singsong voice and dances to an unheard rhythm, moving up to its Speed in a random direction at the start of each of its turns.

reactions.name: Criss Cross
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature within 60 feet of the lepidoptera touches it or hits it with an attack. Response—Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17, the attacker. Failure: The attack deals no damage and the attacker is transported from the Material Plane to the Border Ethereal, or vice versa.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, this dreg can gain Advantage on all melee attack rolls until the start of its next turn, but attack rolls against it have Advantage during that time.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dreg makes two attacks with its Claws.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage. Critical Hit: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target gains one level of Contamination.

bonus_actions.name: Bounding Leap
bonus_actions.desc: The dreg jumps 20 feet. This movement does not count toward its total movement for the round.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the trolling remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a patch of mushrooms.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.desc: When the trolling dies, it explodes in a burst of mind-affecting spores. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature that isn't a troll in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the troll. Failure: 9 (2d8) Psychic damage and has the Weakened condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Spore Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.desc: At the start of its turn, the garmyr can gain Advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have Advantage until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Scent of Blood
traits.desc: The garmyr's melee attacks deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a Bloodied creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The garmyr makes three Battleaxe attacks. It can also Howl, if available.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the garmyr. Critical Hit: The target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Howl (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each Hostile creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the garmyr that can hear it. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

bonus_actions.name: Aggressive
bonus_actions.desc: The garmyr takes the Dash action to move toward a Hostile creature it can see.

reactions.name: Retaliate
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature hits the garmyr with a melee attack. Response: The garmyr makes a Battleaxe attack against that creature.

sb.name: Garmyr Bloodhound

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The garmyr has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmyr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Skilled Hunter
traits.desc: The garmyr's ranged attacks ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover.

traits.name: Kill Shot
traits.desc: The garmyr's ranged attacks deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a Bloodied creature.

actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the start of the garmyr's next turn.

bonus_actions.desc: The garmyr casts [[Tools/Spells/Hunter'S Mark|Hunter's Mark]], using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Blood Call
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4).

- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bane|Bane]], [[Tools/Spells/Bless|Bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Crusader'S Mantle|Crusader's Mantle]]

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Soulbinding Mace
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The target has the Jinxed condition (1d6; save ends).

actions.name: Abyssal Pull
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the target is pulled 15 feet toward the ghoul lord.

bonus_actions.name: Shield Slam
bonus_actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature within 5 feet of the ghoul lord. Failure: The target is pushed 10 feet away from the ghoul lord and has the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Unyielding
reactions.desc: Trigger: The ghoul lord is subjected to an effect that would move it, cause it to have the Prone condition, or both. Failure: The ghoul lord is neither moved nor has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Deathly Teeth
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the start of the ghoul priest's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Reanimate
bonus_actions.desc: The ghoul priest chooses the corpse of a ghoul it can see within 60 feet. The ghoul returns to life with 5 Hit Points and stands up.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The giant ratling has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant ratling makes two Claw attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace up to two attacks with uses of Hurl Ratling.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage. Critical Hit: The target has the Staggered condition until the start of the giant ratling's next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Hurl Ratling
actions.desc: The giant ratling picks up a willing Medium or smaller ratling ally or corpse within 5 feet. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the giant ratling can see within 30 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The hurled ratling takes the same damage and lands with the Prone condition.

bonus_actions.name: Enrage (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: The giant ratling gains 15 Temporary Hit Points. Until the Temporary Hit Points are lost, the giant ratling has Advantage on Strength-based D20 Tests.

sb.name: Graffiti
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
sb.senses: Blindsight 120 ft., Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 20

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.desc: The graffiti is incapacitated while in the area of antimagic. If targeted by [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], the graffiti must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or become Unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The graffiti regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the graffiti is splashed with water, targeted by [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]], or takes Cold damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Solvent Susceptibility
traits.desc: The graffiti is instantly destroyed by Universal Solvent.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The graffiti can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Surface Bound
traits.desc: The graffiti can only move along contiguous flat surfaces, such as walls or floors.

actions.name: Satire
actions.desc: The graffiti shapes itself into a satirical representation of a foe. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 60 feet that can see the graffiti. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of the graffiti's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Transposition
actions.desc: The air quivers around creatures near the graffiti. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 15, up to five creatures the graffiti can see within 120 feet. Failure: The creature teleports to an unoccupied space capable of supporting the creature within 120 feet.

actions.name: Summon Public Opinion (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The graffiti conjures a swarm of Drakkenheim citizen spirits within 120 feet of itself. The swarm uses the Chorus stat block. The chorus acts immediately after the graffiti on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the graffiti. The chorus disappears after 1 minute or the graffiti dies

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The graffiti casts one of the following spells,requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Hallucinatory Terrain|Hallucinatory Terrain]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|Major Image]]

sb.name: Grasping Shadow
sb.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, radiant, thunder
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
sb.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but mostly just screams

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The shadow can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Spectral Grasp
actions.desc: The shadow causes one creature it can see within 5 feet to have the Grappled condition. A target that takes an action to escape automatically ends the grapple.

actions.name: Death Row
actions.desc: The shadow moves up to its Speed, pulling a creature it has Grappled with it.

traits.name: Dazzling Aura
traits.desc: The gravekeeper sheds Bright Light in a 60-foot radius. A creature that starts its turn in the Bright Light takes 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: The gravekeeper always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On its turn, the gravekeeper can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the gravekeeper takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Lantern Blast
actions.desc:
Magical octarine beams flash from one of the Gravekeeper's many lanterns at one creature it can see within 120 feet that is not behind Total Cover, subjecting it to one of the following effects (the gravekeeper can only use each blast once per round):

- **Dispelling Blast.** Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage. Any spell or magical effect on the target ends, and it has the Bewildered condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.
- **Forceful Blast.** Strength Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 35 (10d6) Force damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the gravekeeper and has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.
- **Blinding Blast.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 35 (10d6) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.
- **Contaminating Blast.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 35 (10d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Success: Half damage only.
- **Igniting Blast.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 35 (10d6) Fire damage, and the target has the Burning condition (10d6 Fire). Success: Half damage only.
- **Freezing Blast.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: 35 (10d6) Cold damage, and the target has the Frozen condition (DC 18). Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Glide (1/Round)
actions.desc: The gravekeeper moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Sludge Column (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 10-foot radius, 60-foot tall Cylinder, centered on a point within 120 feet of the Gravekeeper. Failure: 42 (12d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Animate Walls (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature within 10 feet of any number of walls within 120 feet of the gravekeeper. Failure: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). The wall sprouts limbs to facilitate this grapple, which disappear when the condition ends.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The gravekeeper chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting it and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The gravekeeper can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claws

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 14 (3d6 + 4) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The vampire casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|Charm Person]], [[Tools/Spells/Command|Command]], [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|Disguise Self]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Nystul'S Magic Aura|Nystul's Magic Aura]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|Major Image]] (level 4 version), [[Tools/Spells/Nondetection|Nondetection]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|Suggestion]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Animate Dead|Animate Dead]], [[Tools/Spells/Arcane Eye|Arcane Eye]], [[Tools/Spells/Mislead|Mislead]], [[Tools/Spells/Seeming|Seeming]]

bonus_actions.desc: The vampire teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

traits.name: Misty Camouflage
traits.desc: The gargantuan has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in any area obscured by mist or fog, including the Deep Haze of Drakkenheim.

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 15 ft. Hit: 40 (4d10 + 8) Bludgeoning damage.

Hit or Miss: The delerium chunk explodes creating the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, the targeted creature and each creature within 10 feet of it. Failure: 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: An Arcane Anomalies occurs in the space where the delerium chunk exploded.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bile Blast
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 10-foot cone. Failure: 9 (2d8) Acid damage and are Burning (2d8 Acid). Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Hurl Fetid Flesh (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The Gutbuster Hulk rips off a chunk of its mutated flesh and hurls it at a point it can see within 120 feet. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Failure: 28 (8d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.desc: The dreg can take one Reaction on every turn in combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dreg makes two Gut Flail attacks.

actions.name: Gut Flail
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 15 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage and the target has the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Flailing Guts
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature enters a space within 15 feet of it. Response: The dreg makes one Gut Flail attack against that creature.

traits.name: Mutant Fortitude

When the hulk enters another creature's space for the first time during this movement, it can make one Slam attack against that creature. If the target is a creature, it is subject to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The targeted creature has the Prone condition.

sb.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Death Burst
reactions.desc: Trigger: The haze husk is reduced to 0 Hit Points by damage that isn't Radiant or from a Critical Hit. Response—Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the haze husk. Failure: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target gains one Contamination level.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 76 (8d8 + 40) plus 76 (8d8 + 40) per player character

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.desc: A creature starting its turn within 30 feet of Lenore is subjected to the following effect: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The target gains a Contamination level. Failure or Success: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Tendrils
traits.desc: Lenore's long hair can latch onto surfaces to pull her in any direction. She has a Flying Speed of 40 feet (included in Speed) but cannot move more than 30 feet from a solid surface, including walls and ceilings.

actions.name: Lenore always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On her turn, she can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Lenore takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn.

actions.name: Tentacle Hair
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Contaminated Eye Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Force damage, plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Grim Reveal (1/Round)
actions.desc: Lenore removes her mask, revealing her horrific form. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 19, creatures within 60 feet of her who can see her. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Octarine Wall (1/Day)
actions.desc: Lenore summons a shimmering wall within 120 feet of her. The wall can be up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick. Alternatively, she can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point she can see within range. The wall has three octarine layers. When a creature attempts to reach into or pass through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the wall's layers. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19. Failure: Layer 1: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of Contamination and has the Dazed condition; Layer 2: 17 (5d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains two levels of Contamination and has the Defenseless condition; Layer 3: 35 (10d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains three levels of Contamination and the Helpless condition. Success: Half damage only. The wall can be destroyed by taking at least 100 Radiant or Force damage.

actions.name: Radiant Gaze (1/Round)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 44 (8d10) Radiant damage and the target gains one level of Contamination. Success: Half damage only. If Lenore sees her reflection within the Cone, she gains the Blinded and Incapacitated conditions for 1d6 hours and can't take the Epic Resistance Epic Action for the duration.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: Lenore chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11 or higher, the effect ends on her. Lenore can use this Epic Action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

sb.name: Haze Wight
sb.languages: The languages it knew in life

bonus_actions.name: Animate Haze Husk
bonus_actions.desc: The haze wight reanimates the corpse of a haze husk it can see within 60 feet. The haze husk is revived with 5 Hit Points and immediately stands.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The vampire is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The vampire may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The vampire has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the vampire's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Contaminated Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Contaminated Bite
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 17 (4d6 + 3) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Delerium Healing
actions.desc: The vampire touches a delerium shard and regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the vampire has used a delerium shard in this way, it can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

bonus_actions.name: Aggressive
bonus_actions.desc: The vampire moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile creature it can see.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Crone Songs
actions.desc: The harpy sings a magical melody in a 60-foot Emanation, choosing one of the following effects. Allies of the Crone are unaffected.

actions.name: Breakneck Hymn
actions.desc: Each creature in the Emanation that can hear the harpy has Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage from falling until the start of the harpy's next turn.

actions.name: Disarming Tune
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the Emanation that can hear the harpy. Failure: The target has the Weakened condition until the start of the harpy's next turn.

actions.name: Mesmerizing Melody
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the Emanation that can hear the harpy. Failure: 7 (2d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the start of the harpy's next turn.

actions.name: Piercing Notes
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the Emanation that can hear the harpy. Failure: 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. Success: Half damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aerial Maneuver
bonus_actions.desc: The harpy takes the Dash or Disengage action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The harpy makes two attacks.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aerial Maneuver
bonus_actions.desc: The harpy takes the Dash or Disengage action.

reactions.name: Chorus
reactions.desc: Trigger: The harpy is within the area of another harpy's song. Response: The harpy joins in on the song, choosing a creature within 30 feet. The target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw against the song.

traits.name: Pluck
traits.desc: The harpy doesn't need to spend extra movement to drag a Medium or smaller creature Grappled by it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The harpy makes three attacks.

actions.name: Grasping Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the harpy can't use its Grasping Talons on another target.

actions.name: Barbed Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Lightning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aerial Maneuver
bonus_actions.desc: The harpy takes the Dash or Disengage action.

reactions.name: Chorus
reactions.desc: Trigger: The harpy is within the area of another harpy's song. Response: The harpy joins in on the song, choosing a creature within 30 feet. The target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw against the song.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. If the target has the Incapacitated condition, its Intelligence score is reduced by 1d4 until it finishes a Short or Long Rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its Intelligence score to 0.

actions.name: Delerium Dust (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the hazewing moth. Failure: 14 (4d6) Radiant damage, and the target has the Addled condition (save ends).

bonus_actions.name: Hypnotic Flutter
bonus_actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation of the hazewing moth that can see it (hazewing moths automatically succeed). Failure: The target has the Slowed condition (save ends). If the target is already Slowed, it instead has the Immobilized condition (save ends). If the target is already Immobilized, it also has the Incapacitated condition (save ends both).

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

sb.name: Hazewing Moth Chrysalis
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained

traits.name: Anchored
traits.desc: The chrysalis is firmly anchored in place. It can't be forced to move or teleport unless it chooses to be.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.desc: The chrysalis conjures Deep Haze in a 30-foot Emanation, which renders its area Lightly Obscured. A creature that starts its turn in the area is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target gains one Contamination level. Failure or Success: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Harden
actions.desc: The chrysalis regains 7 (2d6) Hit Points, gaining any excess healing as Temporary Hit Points.

reactions.name: Sudden Emergence
reactions.desc: Trigger: The chrysalis is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Response: Roll 1d6. On a 6, a Hazewing Moth Adult emerges from the chrysalis, sharing its Initiative count. On a 1-5, vile goo spills out of the chrysalis, and each creature within 5 feet of it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target gains one Contamination level. Failure or Success: 10 (3d6) Acid damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 125 (7d20 + 49) plus 125 (7d20 + 49) per player character

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.desc: He Who Laughs Last is immune to any effect that would sense his emotions or read his thoughts, as well as any divination spell that he refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the demon lord's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Mortal Coil
traits.desc: He Who Laughs Last projects a 150-foot Emanation of death and decay. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation suffers an Exhaustion level and ages 10 (3d6) years. The creature removes an Exhaustion level gained in this way at the end of its turn, but only if it ends its turn outside the Emanation. A creature's original age can be restored with [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|Greater Restoration]] or similar magic.

actions.name: He Who Laughs Last always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On his turn, He Who Laughs Last can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, He Who Laughs Last takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Scornful Whip.** Melee Attack Roll: +16, reach 120 ft. Hit: 30 (5d8 + 8) Force damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pulled 30 feet toward He Who Laughs Last.
- **Walking Shadow (1/Round).** He Who Laughs Last moves up to half his Speed.

actions.name: Sleep No More (1/Round)
actions.desc: He Who Laughs Last casts [[Tools/Spells/Power Word Kill|Power Word Kill]].

actions.name: Out Brief Candle (1/Round)
actions.desc: He Who Laughs Last casts [[Tools/Spells/Finger Of Death|Finger of Death]] (save DC 24).

actions.name: Dusty Death (1/Round)
actions.desc: He Who Laughs Last casts [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|Disintegrate]] (save DC 24).

actions.name: Cage of Sorrows (1/Round)
actions.desc: He Who Laughs Last creates a wall of bone on a solid surface it can see within 120 feet of himself. The wall appears as a flat surface made up of one 10-foot-square panel. The wall is 1 foot thick and lasts for 1 minute or until the wall is destroyed (AC 15, 20 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, Vulnerability to Bludgeoning and Thunder damage). If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (GM's choice) and subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 10 (3d6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: He Who Laughs Last chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He Who Laughs Last can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

actions.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
actions.desc:
He Who Laughs Last casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 26):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Animate Dead|Animate Dead]] (level 9 version), [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Dead|Speak with Dead]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Create Undead|Create Undead]] (level 9 version), [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Dream|Dream]], [[Tools/Spells/Project Image|Project Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|Teleport]]
- **1/Year:** [[Tools/Spells/Wish|Wish]]

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The hand can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Finger Jab
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Latch
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: The hand attaches itself to the target. While latched, the hand cannot attack. Instead, at the start of each of the hand's turns, the latched creature takes 2 (1d4) Necrotic damage. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the hand with a successful DC 13 Strength check. The hand can also detach itself at any time during its turn (no action required).

bonus_actions.name: Helper
bonus_actions.desc: The hand takes the Help action.

actions.name: Spiritual Weapon
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Ophelia casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16, +8 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|Guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Spare The Dying|Spare the Dying]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Aura Of Vitality|Aura of Vitality]], [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|Banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Bless|Bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Flame Strike|Flame Strike]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|Greater Restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Cure Wounds|Mass Cure Wounds]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Heal|Heal]], [[Tools/Spells/Raise Dead|Raise Dead]], [[Tools/Spells/Sunbeam|Sunbeam]]

bonus_actions.name: Healing Word (3/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Ophelia casts [[Tools/Spells/Healing Word|Healing Word]] using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 10 (3d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.desc: The apothecary touches another creature. The target regains 20 (4d8 + 2) Hit Points, and the apothecary ends one disease or condition affecting the target, choosing from the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned conditions.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The apothecary casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to spell attacks):

- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Aid|Aid]], [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|Lesser Restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Protection From Poison|Protection from Poison]], [[Tools/Spells/Purge Contamination|Purge Contamination]]

bonus_actions.name: Adrenaline Boost
bonus_actions.desc: One ally within 5 feet of the apothecary can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed and make an attack.

actions.name: Longbow

bonus_actions.name: Quarry
bonus_actions.desc: The scout casts [[Tools/Spells/Hunter'S Mark|Hunter's Mark]], using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Powder Keg
traits.desc: If the trapper takes damage from a critical hit, it must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or the attack ruptures their alchemical supplies and gunpowder. Each creature within 15 feet of the trapper (including the trapper) is subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 28 (8d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Trapper's Crossbow
actions.desc:
Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60/120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to one of the following effects of the trapper's choice:

- **Bola Shot.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Prone condition.
- **Tranquilizer Shot.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Dazed condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Net Shot (1/Day)
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Immobilized condition (save ends).

actions.name: Set Trap (5/Day)
actions.desc:
The trapper sets a trap in a space within 5 feet of it. A creature that moves within 5 feet of the trap immediately sets it off, affecting each creature in a 5-foot radius centered on the trap. The trap can be one of the options listed for the Trapper's Crossbow or one of the following additional options:

- **Fire Trap.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Burning condition (1d8).
- **Shock Trap.** Strength Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn.
- **Frost Trap.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Frozen condition (DC 10).

bonus_actions.name: Smoke Bomb (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: The trapper casts [[Tools/Spells/Fog Cloud|Fog Cloud]] without the need for components, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

sb.name: Hooded Lantern Veteran

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow

The veteran casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to spell attacks):

bonus_actions.desc: The veteran casts [[Tools/Spells/Hunter'S Mark|Hunter's Mark]], using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

bonus_actions.desc: The veteran moves up to 30 feet in a straight line in any direction, provided it ends its turn adjacent to a solid surface.

traits.desc: 54 (4d12 + 28) plus 54 (4d12 + 28) per player character

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the troll remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a gigantic mushroom.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The troll regains 30 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Rotting Aura
traits.desc: Any creature who starts its turn in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the troll takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage unless the troll has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: On its turn, the troll can move as normal
actions.desc: However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the troll takes one of the following Epic Actions of its choice at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Spore Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 33 (6d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grasping Tendrils
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 60 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Slashing damage and if the target is Huge or smaller, the troll pulls the target up to 20 feet straight towards itself.

actions.name: Entangling Mycelia (Recharge when Bloodied)
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature of the troll's choice in a 30-foot radius centered on it. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition (save ends).

actions.name: Spawn Trolling (1/Round)
actions.desc: The troll creates a Fungal Trolling which appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. The fungal trolling acts immediately after the troll uses this action, then acts after the troll's turn on subsequent rounds.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The troll chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. A troll can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hulk makes two Lashing Tendril attacks and one Belly Maw attack.

actions.name: Lashing Tendrils
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 60 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). The hulk can grapple up to two creatures at once.

actions.name: Belly Maw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The hulk casts [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]] on itself, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spell-casting ability.

bonus_actions.name: Reel
bonus_actions.desc: The hulk pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the eldritch blossom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary flower.

actions.name: Contaminated Touch
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target gains one Contamination level. If the target is Charmed by the eldritch blossom, it is hit automatically and has Disadvantage on its save.

actions.name: Hypnotic Pollen (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the eldritch blossom. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition for 1 minute. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and must approach the eldritch blossom on its turns, taking the most direct path possible and moving through hazards. The effect ends early if a creature takes an action to shake the target out of its stupor.

reactions.name: Spell Reflection
reactions.desc: Trigger: The eldritch blossom succeeds on its save against a spell that targets only the eldritch blossom and doesn't have an area of effect, or a spell attack misses the eldritch blossom. Response: The eldritch blossom chooses a creature it can see within 30 feet as the spell's new target (the original caster is a valid target). If the spell forces a saving throw, the new target makes its own save. If the spell has an attack roll, the original caster rerolls the attack against the new target.

sb.name: Injector
sb.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The injector makes four Syringe attacks. It can replace any number of attacks with uses of Booster Dose instead.

actions.name: Syringe
actions.desc:
Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to one of the following effects (roll 1d4; reroll if the injector has already used that effect during this turn):

- **Lethal Injection.** The target takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage.
- **Numbing Solution.** The target takes 9 (2d8) Cold damage and is subjected to the following effect: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target has the Frozen condition (DC 16).
- **Mind Dampener.** The target takes 7 (2d6) Psychic damage and is subjected to the following effect: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target has the Bewildered condition (save ends).
- **Induced Necrosis.** The target takes 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect: Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target has the Weakened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Booster Dose
actions.desc: The injector administers a tincture to a Friendly creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct, choosing from the effects below. Once a creature benefits from a tincture, it can't gain that benefit again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Adrenaline Rush
actions.desc: The target can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action or make one weapon attack with Advantage.

actions.name: Inoculation
actions.desc: The injector chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison damage. The target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type for 1 minute.

actions.name: Restorative Fluid
actions.desc: The target regains 35 10d6 Hit Points. If the target is already at its Hit Point Maximum, it gains these as Temporary Hit Points instead.

actions.name: Focus
actions.desc: The target has the Valor condition 1d4 for 1 minute.

reactions.name: Unstable Tank
reactions.desc: Trigger: The injector would take damage. Response: The injector reduces that damage to 0, and one of its tanks violently explodes. The injector chooses one of the effects of its Syringe or Booster Dose. Each creature within 20 feet of it is affected as if the Injector hit it with its Syringe or used Booster Dose on it. The injector can't use that effect until it finishes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Normal Semblance

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Surgical Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4).

actions.name: Syringe (1/Day)

Failure or Success: If this Poison damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it is stabilized but has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Latch (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The harvester moves up to its Speed. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of a Medium or larger creature, it can make one Surgical Claw attack against that creature. Hit: The harvester attaches to the target. While attached, the harvester has Advantage on attack rolls against the target. The attached harvester moves with the target, using none of the harvester's movement. The harvester can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement on its turn. A creature within 5 feet, including the target, can take an action to detach the harvester with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: The harvester takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

sb.name: Interloper
sb.languages: telepathy 90 ft. (conveys simple emotions) understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The interloper is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The interloper may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.desc: The interloper is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the interloper's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: Interloper is immune to the Jinxed condition.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The interloper makes one Spindly Claw attack and one Suckered Bite attack. If the interloper has used Siphon Spell since the end of its last turn, it can instead make three Spindly Claw or Suckered Bite attacks.

actions.name: Spindly Claw
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature within 5 ft. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage and the target gains one Contamination level. Succes: half damage only.

actions.name: Suckered Bite
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 5ft. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and the target has the Bewildered condition (save ends) and the interloper regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Success: half damage only.

actions.name: Delerium Healing
actions.desc: The interloper touches a delerium shard and regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, that shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

actions.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
actions.desc: The interloper casts [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|Plane Shift]] targeting only itself, requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport

reactions.name: Siphon Spell
reactions.desc: Trigger: A spell is cast by a creature within 60 feet of the interloper. Response - Intelligence Saving throw: DC 14, that creature. Failure: 11 (2d10) Psychic damage and the spell fails, but no resources are expended by the spell's casting.

traits.name: Regenerate
traits.desc: The hulk regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the hulk takes Acid or Cold damage, this trait doesn't function on the hulk's next turn. The hulk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Out of My Way
traits.desc: The hulk moves more than 10 feet in a straight line. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature within 5 feet of its path. Failure: The target is pushed 5 feet away from the hulk and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hulk makes two Rusty Blade attacks. It can replace one Rusty Blade attack with Whirlwind if available.

actions.name: Rusty Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage and the creature gains the Bleeding 2d6 condition.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The hulk twirls its blades around it in a violent, heavy swing. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature within 10 feet of the hulk. Failure: 27 (6d6 + 6) Slashing damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Rip and Tear
bonus_actions.desc: The hulk makes one Rusty Blade attack against a Prone creature.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 92 (8d12 + 40) plus 92 (8d12 + 40) per player character

traits.name: Corrosive Aura
traits.desc: The area within 30 feet of the hydra is filled with corrosive fumes and is Lightly Obscured. A creature that starts its turn in the fumes takes 20 (8d4) Acid damage.

traits.name: Head Count
traits.desc: The hydra can't make more Bite or Spit Acid attacks each round than it has heads, and each head can only be used to make one Bite or Spit Acid attack each round.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.desc: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more in a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all of its heads are dead.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.desc: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attack action.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: The hydra is immune to the Burning (Acid only) condition.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.desc: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: The hydra always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On its turn, the hydra can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the hydra takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 20 ft. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spit Acid
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +14, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 20 (8d4) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (8d4 Acid). While Burning, the target has the Blinded condition.

actions.name: Grow Heads
actions.desc: The hydra can only perform this Epic Action if one or more of its heads died this round, unless the head was killed by Fire damage. The hydra grows two heads, and regains 20 Hit Points.

actions.name: Hydra Fury (1/Round)
actions.desc: The hydra makes one Bite attack or one Spit Acid attack for each head that hasn't yet made an attack this round.

actions.name: Trample (1/Round)

actions.name: Tail (1/Round)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 15 ft. Hit: 34 (4d12 + 8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away from the hydra.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The hydra chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The hydra can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within 30 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Radiant damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: Eternal Torment
traits.desc: If a last memory dies, it reappears 1d4 days later, unleashing a howling scream that can be heard up to 300 feet away.

traits.name: Silhouette
traits.desc: The last memory can only move along contiguous flat surfaces, such as walls or floors. It cannot fly or swim and must always be in contact with a surface. Additionally, the last memory ignores all natural Difficult Terrain and can climb without making an ability check.

traits.desc: The last memory doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Anguish (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the last memory that can hear it. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and the target becomes Jinxed 1d6 (save ends).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Lenore makes three attacks with her Tentacle Hair.

actions.name: Tentacle Hair
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target gains one level of Contamination.

bonus_actions.name: Radiant Gaze (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 22 (4d10) Radiant damage and the target gains one level of Contamination. Success: Half damage only. traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.desc: The liminal herald is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the liminal herald's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The liminal herald makes two Eldritch Beam or contaminated touch attacks. It can also use Mind Scramble or Warp Call.

actions.name: Contaminated Touch
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one target within 5 ft. Failure: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and the target gains one Contamination level. Success: half damage only.

actions.name: Eldritch Beam
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 120 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Force damage.

actions.name: Mind Scramble (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone (creatures maintaining Concentration have Disadvantage). Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, or 28 (8d6) Psychic damage if the target is maintaining Concentration.

actions.name: Warp Call
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the liminal herald can see within 90 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target is teleported into an unoccupied space the liminal herald can see within 60 feet. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.

bonus_actions.name: Dimension Hop
bonus_actions.desc: The liminal herald teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

reactions.name: Reflect Pain
reactions.desc: Trigger: The liminal herald takes damage from an attack or spell that only targets it. Response: The attacker or spellcaster takes Psychic damage equal to the damage dealt by the triggering attack or spell.

traits.name: Hazardous Fumes
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the ooze has the Burning condition (4d4 Acid). While Burning, the creature also has the Slowed condition. While the creature remains within 10 feet of the ooze, the Burning condition cannot be removed in any way.

traits.name: Liquid Form
traits.desc: The ooze can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 10 (4d4) Acid damage. The ooze has Advantage on ability checks it makes to initiate or escape a grapple.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The ooze can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ooze makes two Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (4d4) Acid damage.

traits.name: Digestive Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn in the living city's space takes 10 (4d4) Acid damage. At the start of its turn, the living city decides whether its Digestive Aura is active until the start of its next turn (no action required).

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the living city remains motionless in its Structural Form, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary structure or vehicle, such as a house or a sailing ship.

traits.name: Structural Form
traits.desc: The living city can spend 10 minutes in Concentration to shape-shift into a Gargantuan structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. While in the form of a structure, the living city takes up its entire space and creates floors, walls, doorways, and windows within its space which resemble and behave like normal structures, while leaving behind open space within it to create rooms. Creatures can pass through the open spaces and stop there as if moving through a normal structure. The walls and floors of the living city can be damaged and thus breached. Each 5-foot-by-5-foot section has AC 15 and 30 Hit Points. Reducing a section to 0 Hit Points destroys it and deals 30 damage to the living city. A living city can only take this damage once per turn. In addition, the living city extrudes pieces of itself inside its space which resemble furnishings and everyday objects. The extrusions appear, feel, sound, and behave exactly like the mimicked objects. A thin, slimy tendril connects any furnishings or objects to the body of the living city. The tendril has AC 15 and 1 Hit Point. If the tether is severed or destroyed, the simulacra melts into goo, but does no harm to the living city.

traits.name: No Exit
traits.desc: When it rolls for Initiative, the living city reflexively closes the windows, doors, and other egress points on the outside of its body, preventing creatures inside it from leaving its space. A creature in the living city's space that attempts to leave its space using teleportation or planar travel is subjected to the following effect. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 27 (5d10) Psychic damage. Failure or Success: The teleportation or planar travel fails.

actions.name: The living city always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On its turn, the living city can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the living city takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 0 ft. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Grasping Tendril
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed or pulled 10 feet (the living city's choice).

actions.name: Haunting Whispers
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature in the living city's space. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

Creatures inside the living city who are not directly observing the shift must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the change. If the living city creates a wall that cuts through another creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the living city's choice). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its Reaction to move up to its speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The living city chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. If the egg is still attached to the target at the end of its next turn, the target is infected with a disease and has the Sickened condition until the disease ends.
