- **Claws.** Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).
- **Poison Arrow.** Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Poison damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition (save ends).
- **Ensnaring Arrow.** Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Restrained condition (DC 17 Dexterity saving throw ends).
- **Harpoon Arrow.** Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it is pulled up to 20 feet toward the Lord of the Feast.

actions.name: Reposition
actions.desc: The Lord of the Feast moves up to his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Call of the Hunt (1/Round)
actions.desc: The Lord of the Feast releases a blood-curdling howl that can be heard all across Drakkenheim. All garmyr in the city heed this call and rush towards the Lord of the Feast's current position. Each garmyr within 60 feet who can see and hear the Lord of the Feast can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make one melee or ranged attack with Advantage.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The Lord of the Feast chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. The Lord of the Feast can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 68 (15d8) plus 68 (15d8) per player character

traits.name: Holy Aura
traits.desc: Lucretia projects a 60-foot Emanation of holy power. At the start of each of her turns, she can choose the aura's effect, which applies to creatures of her choice in the Emanation:

traits.name: Divine Grace
traits.desc: Creatures in the Emanation that target Lucretia with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This effect doesn't protect Lucretia from area effects, such as the explosion of a [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|Fireball]]. If Lucretia makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage to another creature, this trait ends until the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Pacifying Presence
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation has the Weakened condition until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Wrathful Flame
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 10 (3d6) Radiant damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

traits.name: Prescient
traits.desc: Lucretia can't be surprised while she is conscious.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.desc: When Lucretia dies, her soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in her chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: Lucretia Mathias is immune to the Contamination condition.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While Lucretia is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Wisdom modifier (included above).

traits.name: Undeniable Faith
traits.desc: Lucretia automatically succeeds on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration on her spells.

actions.name: Lucretia always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On her turn, Lucretia can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Lucretia takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Pacifying Touch.** Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature within 5 feet of Lucretia. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target is stabilized but has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, even after regaining Hit Points.
- **Sacred Flame.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature within 60 feet of Lucretia. Failure: 45 (10d8) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Divine Intervention (1/Day)
actions.desc: Lucretia chooses any spell which doesn't require a Reaction to cast. As part of this Epic Action, she casts that spell without Material components. If she uses this Epic Action to cast the [[Tools/Spells/Wish|Wish]] spell, she can't use this Epic Action for the next 1d4 days.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: Lucretia chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. Lucretia can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

actions.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
actions.desc:
Lucretia casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20, +12 to spell attacks; spells other than cantrips are cast at level 9):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|Guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Aid|Aid]], [[Tools/Spells/Bless|Bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|Banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Flame Strike|Flame Strike]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|Hold Person]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Cure Wounds|Mass Cure Wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Commune|Commune]], [[Tools/Spells/Death Ward|Death Ward]], [[Tools/Spells/Divination|Divination]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Dead|Speak with Dead]]

actions.name: Greater Spellcasting (1/Round)
actions.desc:
Lucretia casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20, +12 to spell attacks; spells other than cantrips are cast at level 9):

- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Gate|Gate]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|Greater Restoration]], [[Tools/Spells/Heal|Heal]], [[Tools/Spells/Heroes' Feast|Heroes' Feast]], [[Tools/Spells/Resurrection|Resurrection]], [[Tools/Spells/Word Of Recall|Word of Recall]]

sb.name: Lurker on the Threshold
sb.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness), passive Perception 18
sb.languages: telepathy 120 ft. understands all languages but can't speak

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The lurker is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The lurker may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.desc: As an action, the lurker can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the lurker has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.desc: The lurker is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the lurker's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Eldritch Blood
traits.desc: A creature that deals Piercing or Slashing damage to the lurker while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The lurker has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lurker makes three Tendril attacks. It can replace each Tendril attack with a use of Cosmic Rays.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 30 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The lurker has ten tendrils, each of which can grapple one creature.

actions.name: Cosmic Rays
actions.desc:
The lurker randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet (roll 1d4; reroll if the lurker has already used that ray this turn):

- **Disintegrating Ray.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 27 (6d8) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into dust.
- **Memory Lapse Ray.** Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target's memories become distant for 1 minute. While its memories are distant, the target can't take the Magic action, use class features, or understand language, and has Disadvantage on ability checks. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
- **Contaminating Ray.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Success: Half damage only.
- **Existential Dread Ray.** On the target's next turn, each time it takes an action other than the Dodge action, moves more than 5 feet, or takes a Bonus Action, it takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Normal Semblance
traits.desc: The dreg has Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks to disguise itself as, or impersonate, a humanoid creature.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Furious Ambush (Recharges on a Short Rest)
actions.desc: The dreg makes two Dagger attacks.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: The dreg takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Cold damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: The troll is immune to the Burning condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll makes two Fiery Claw attacks and one Volcanic Bite attack. It can replace its Volcanic Bite attack with Sulphurous Belch, if available.

actions.name: Volcanic Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fiery Claw
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 120 feet. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire).

actions.name: Sulfurous Belch (Recharges 5-6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on the troll. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage and has the Blinded condition until it or another creature within 5 of it uses an action to clean the ash from their eyes. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Academy Rings (1/Day)
traits.desc: The mage can cast a spell from Spellcasting without expending a use of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mage makes three Prismatic Blast attacks.

actions.name: Prismatic Blast
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (mage's choice).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included above), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/Unseen Servant|Unseen Servant]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Fly|Fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Ice Storm|Ice Storm]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|Lightning Bolt]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|Banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|Wall of Force]]

reactions.name: Counterspell (Recharge 5–6)
reactions.desc: The mage casts [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]] in response to that spell's trigger, using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The maw vermin has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The maw vermin makes one Bite attack and three Claw attacks, and it can use Grasping Maw or Glob Launcher.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Piercing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and has Total Cover from effects originating outside the maw vermin. At the start of each of the maw vermin's turns, a swallowed creature takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain one Contamination level. The maw vermin can swallow up to three creatures at a time. If the maw vermin takes 20+ damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, the maw vermin must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which land in spaces within 10 feet of the maw vermin with the Prone condition. If the maw vermin dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Slashing damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). Until the grapple ends, the maw vermin can't use this Claw on another target. The maw vermin has three Claws.

actions.name: Grasping Maw
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 18, one Medium or smaller creature the maw vermin can see within 15 feet. Failure: The target is pulled into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the maw vermin.

actions.name: Glob Launcher
actions.desc: The maw vermin coats a swallowed creature in acidic goo and launches it at a point within 120 feet of it. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within 10 feet of the launched creature as it lands (the launched creature automatically fails). Failure: 21 (6d6) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Acid). While Burning, the target has the Restrained condition.

sb.name: Minazorond
sb.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 25

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 95 (7d12 + 49) plus 95 (7d12 + 49) per player character

traits.name: Protective Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Minazorond takes 14 (4d6) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Construct Resilience
traits.desc: If damage reduces Minazorond to 0 Hit Points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a success, Minazorond drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Minazorond always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On its turn, Minazorond can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Minazorond takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Bite.** Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 33 (4d12 + 7) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
- **Claw.** Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 22, one creature Minazorond can see within 20 feet. Failure: 14 (4d6) Force damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Shocking Burst
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, one target Minazorond can see within 120 feet. Failure: 22 (4d10) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Terrifying Roar (Recharges after a Short Rest)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 120-foot Emanation originating from Minazorond that can hear it. Failure: 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Breathe Deep (1/Round)
actions.desc: Minazorond's Breath Weapon recharges. Minazorond can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action it has taken this round.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
actions.desc: Minazorond uses one of the following breath weapons. It can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action it takes this round.

actions.name: Lightning Breath
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 22, each creature in a 120-foot Cone. Failure: 81 (16d8) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Thunder Breath
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 22, each creature in a 120-foot Cone. Failure: 66 (12d10) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from Minazorond and has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: Double damage, and the target also has the Deafened condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: Minazorond chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. Minazorond can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

reactions.name: Draconic Rebuke
reactions.desc: Trigger: Minazorond becomes Bloodied. It can use this Reaction even if it has the Incapacitated condition or is otherwise unable to take Reactions. Response: All conditions and spells on Minazorond immediately end unless it chooses to be affected by them, and it can fly up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action and ignoring Difficult Terrain. Minazorond recharges and immediately uses its Terrifying Roar.

sb.name: Mind Leech
sb.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Aquatic Camouflage
traits.desc: The leech has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

traits.name: Memory Bank
traits.desc: The leech has three memory banks in its body. When encountered, roll 1d3 to determine how many memory banks are filled with grey matter. The rest are empty.

actions.name: Attach
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 0 ft. Hit: The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure: The leech is still detached, but the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Brain Drain
bonus_actions.desc: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature. That creature is subjected to the following effect. Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target's Intelligence score is reduced by 1d4, and one of the leech's memory banks is filled. If this effect reduces the target's Intelligence score to 0, it has the Unconscious condition until it regains at least 1 point of Intelligence. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the creature finishes a Short or Long Rest.

bonus_actions.name: Thought Transfusion
bonus_actions.desc: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled memory bank. The attached creature gains Advantage on Intelligence-based D20 Tests for 1 minute, and the leech empties one of its filled memory banks.

traits.name: Unshakeable Faith (1/Day)
traits.desc: When the missionary would fail a saving throw, it can reroll the save with Advantage. It must use the new roll.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) Bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Sacred Fire
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The missionary casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bless|Bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Spirit Guardians|Spirit Guardians]]

bonus_actions.name: Healing Word (3/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The missionary casts [[Tools/Spells/Healing Word|Healing Word]] using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

traits.name: Noxious Blood
traits.desc: When a creature hits the mutagenist with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the creature takes 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mutagenist makes two Scalpel attacks and uses Forced Mutation.

actions.name: Scalpel
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d6).

actions.name: Forced Mutation
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the mutagenist can see within 60 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, and the target gains a randomly determined mutation. The mutation lasts for 1 minute, and afterwards, any lost body parts are restored. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Transmogrifying Elixir (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The mutagenist injects itself with a transmogrifying elixir. The mutagenist transforms, using the Grotesque Gargantuan stat block for their altered form. The mutagenist reverts to its normal form after 1 hour or if its transmogrified form is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The mutagenist casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|Alter Self]]
- **2/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Enhance Ability|Enhance Ability]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|Polymorph]]

bonus_actions.name: Anatomical Precision
bonus_actions.desc: The mutagenist gains Advantage on Scalpel attacks until the start of its next turn, as long as it has not moved this turn. The mutagenist's Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.

reactions.name: Desperate Transformation
reactions.desc: Trigger: The mutagenist is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Response: The mutagenist uses Transmogrifying Elixir, if available.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.desc: When Nathaniel dies, his soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in his chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: Nathaniel is immune to the Contamination condition.

actions.name: Sacred Fire
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 35 (10d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Nathaniel casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included above), [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bless|Bless]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fireball|Fireball]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Aid|Aid]] (level 5 version), [[Tools/Spells/Spirit Guardians|Spirit Guardians]]

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.desc: The vampire has Advantage on attack rolls against a target with the Bloodied or Bleeding condition.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Spectral Weapons
actions.desc:
Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 100/400 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Force damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of the vampire's choice (the vampire can't select the same option more than once per turn):

- **Poison.** The target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition (save ends, Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16).
- **Open Wounds.** The target has the Bleeding condition (3d6).
- **Mindmuddler.** The target has the Bewildered condition (save ends, Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16).

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 15 (3d6 + 5) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonus_actions.name: Meld Into Shadow
bonus_actions.desc: In Dim Light or Darkness, the vampire casts [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]] on itself, requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability.

reactions.name: Spectral Dodge
reactions.desc: Trigger: The vampire takes damage. Response: The vampire gains Resistance to that damage, then moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Forest Sense
traits.desc: The troll can pinpoint the location of creatures and moving objects within 120 feet of it as long as both it and the anything it is detecting is in a natural forested area.

traits.name: Shroud of Leaves
traits.desc: The troll is covered head to toe in a shroud of thick leaves. While it has this shroud it is immune to all damage except Fire damage. If the troll takes any Fire damage, the leaves all burn away revealing the gnarled oak wood body of the troll and it loses this trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll makes two Gnarled Claw attacks and one Bite attack

actions.name: Gnarled Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) Piercing damage and if the target is a creature, the target has the Bleeding condition (2d8) as thick splinters pierce and remain in the creature's flesh.

bonus_actions.name: Abundant Growth
bonus_actions.desc: The troll regains its Shroud of Leaves trait.

bonus_actions.name: Leaf Burst
bonus_actions.desc: As long as the troll has its Shroud of Leaves, it can shed its Shroud of Leaves in a burst, losing the trait in the process. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature within 15 feet of the troll. Failure: 7 (2d6) Slashing damage and has the Blinded condition until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Enraged
traits.desc: While Bloodied, the octarine tree gains Advantage on all attack rolls.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: The octarine tree has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to Hide in forests.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The octarine tree deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The octarine tree makes three attacks.

actions.name: Thwack
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 10 feet and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Crushing Roots
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 20 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The octarine tree can grapple up to four creatures at a time.

actions.name: Delerium Fruit
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 60/120 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Necrotic damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target gains one Contamination level. Failure by 5 or More: The target triggers an Arcane Anomalies centered on itself.

bonus_actions.name: Take Root
bonus_actions.desc: If the octarine tree has not moved this round, it can plant itself into the ground. It regains 18 (4d8) Hit Points and has the Immobilized condition until the start of its next turn. While Immobilized, the octarine tree has Immunity to the Grappled, Prone, and Restrained conditions, and its AC increases to 20. These benefits end early if the tree takes Fire damage.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The ratling has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Death Toll
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the ratling can see within 120 feet. Failure: 45 (10d8) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Squeak of Doom (1/Day)
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 16, each Hostile creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the ratling that can hear it. Failure: 55 (10d10) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The ratling casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Divination|Divination]], [[Tools/Spells/Eyebite|Eyebite]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Spirit Guardians|Spirit Guardians]]

bonus_actions.name: Ratling Cunning
bonus_actions.desc: The ratling takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

reactions.name: Tail Barbs
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the ratling can see within 60 feet succeeds on a D20 Test. Response: The ratling forces the triggering creature to reroll the D20 Test and use the lower roll.

sb.name: Pale Man
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 76 (8d8 + 40) plus 76 (8d8 + 40) per player character

traits.name: Aura of Fleshy Insects
traits.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature of the Pale Man's choosing who starts its turn within 60 feet of the Pale Man. Failure: 22 (5d8) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of Contamination.

traits.name: Crawling Flesh
traits.desc: When the Pale Man is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he breaks apart into a Swarm of Contaminated Insects in the same space. Unless the swarm is destroyed, the Pale Man's swarm returns to its cocoon and reforms into the Pale Man 1d6 days later.

traits.name: Insect Body
traits.desc: The Pale Man can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the Pale Man can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect.

actions.name: The Pale Man always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On his turn, the Pale Man can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Pale Man takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn.

actions.name: Contaminating Touch
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Forced Mutation
actions.desc: The Pale Man targets a creature within 60 feet who has one or more mutations and magically alters the mutation. The Pale Man chooses one of the target's existing mutations to remove and replaces it with a different one of his choice.

actions.name: Infest the Flesh (1/Round)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation from the Pale Man. Failure: 22 (5d8) Necrotic damage, and the target gains the Burning (3d8 Necrotic) condition. A target also has the Dazed condition while it is burning in this way. Failure by 5 or more: The target also has the Restrained condition (save ends) due to masses of swarming fleshy bugs. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Contaminate (1/Round)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature Restrained by the Pale Man's Infest the Flesh action. Failure: The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Abrupt Contaminant (1/Round)
actions.desc: The Pale Man targets a creature within 60 feet who has one or more levels of Contamination. That creature takes 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage for each level of Contamination it has.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The Pale Man chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11 or higher, the effect ends on him. The Pale Man can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

actions.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
actions.desc:
The Pale Man casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Inflict Wounds|Inflict Wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included with AC), [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|Magic Missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield|Shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Delerium Orb|Delerium Orb]], [[Tools/Spells/Purge Contamination|Purge Contamination]], [[Tools/Spells/Warp Bolt|Warp Bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Bacterial Barrage|Bacterial Barrage]], [[Tools/Spells/Caustic Grip|Caustic Grip]], [[Tools/Spells/Infect|Infect]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|Bestow Curse]], [[Tools/Spells/Evard'S Black Tentacles|Evard's Black Tentacles]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|Hold Person]], [[Tools/Spells/Web|Web]], [[Tools/Spells/Witch Bolt|Witch Bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Conjure The Deep Haze|Conjure the Deep Haze]], [[Tools/Spells/Delerium Blast|Delerium Blast]], [[Tools/Spells/Forced Evolution|Forced Evolution]], [[Tools/Spells/Blood Worm|Blood Worm]], [[Tools/Spells/Septic Shock|Septic Shock]], [[Tools/Spells/Venomous Aura|Venomous Aura]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Antimagic Field|Antimagic Field]], [[Tools/Spells/Blight|Blight]], [[Tools/Spells/Chain Lightning|Chain Lightning]], [[Tools/Spells/Giant Insect|Giant Insect]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Slow|Slow]], [[Tools/Spells/Octarine Spray|Octarine Spray]], [[Tools/Spells/Siphon Contamination|Siphon Contamination]], [[Tools/Spells/Grievous Wounds|Grievous Wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Vile Necrosis|Vile Necrosis]]

traits.name: Laboratory Adaptation
traits.desc: The pathogenist is immune to disease.

traits.name: Mutated Strains
traits.desc: The pathogenist's attacks and effects ignore the target's [[Tools/Spells/Resistance|Resistance]] or Immunity to Poison damage and Immunity to the Poisoned condition and disease.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pathogenist makes two Poison Needle attacks.

actions.name: Poison Needle
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it is stabilized and has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Pestilent Infection (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The pathogenist infects one creature it can see within 30 feet with a magical disease. At the start of each of its turns, the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, and the target gaines one Exhaustion level. Third Success: The disease ends.

actions.name: Plague Wind (1/Day)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 22 (5d8) Poison damage plus 23 (5d8) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: If the target has 25 Hit Points or fewer after taking this damage, it dies and its flesh turns to ash, leaving a weathered skeleton.

bonus_actions.name: Heightened Tolerance
bonus_actions.desc: The pathogenist ends the Charmed or Frightened condition on itself.

reactions.name: Outbreak
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the pathogenist can see that is infected by its Pestilent Infection is reduced to 0 Hit Points or dies. Response: The pathogenist spreads the disease to another creature it can see within 30 feet of the infected creature.

traits.name: Spell Vessel
traits.desc: After using its Consume Spell Reaction, the phage stores the spell until the spell is digested or the phage dies. When the phage dies, the spell takes effect. If the original caster of the spell sees the phage die, it can choose the area or target(s) of the spell as if they had cast it from the phage's space. Otherwise, the spell affects a random area or target(s) from those within range.

traits.name: Warped Space
traits.desc: The phage magically warps space in a 10-foot Emanation. Attacks targeting the phage from outside the Emanation have Disadvantage, and the phage has Advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that originate from outside the Emanation.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the phage isn't storing a spell, it makes this attack with Advantage and deals an extra 14 (4d6) Piercing damage on a hit.

actions.name: Spit
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60/120 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 3) Acid damage.

actions.name: Digest Spell
actions.desc: The phage digests the spell it has stored, teleporting to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet and making a Spit attack with Advantage.

reactions.name: Consume Spell
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature within 120 feet of the phage casts a spell while the phage isn't storing a spell. Response: The spell has no effect and is stored in the phage.

traits.name: Unshakeable Faith (1/Day)
traits.desc: When the pilgrim would fail a saving throw, it can reroll the save with Advantage. It must use the new roll.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Plague Symptoms
traits.desc: The plague carrier is host to a disease created by a pathogenist, chosen from the options below. A creature infected by this disease is subjected to the chosen effect at the start of each of its turns. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage, and the target suffers the disease's effect. Third Success: The disease ends.

traits.name: Coughing Fits
traits.desc: The target is unable to speak until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Fatigue
traits.desc: The target's Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Shivers
traits.desc: The target shakes uncontrollably. Each time it fails its saving throw, it drops whatever it is holding.

actions.name: Festering Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d8) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The target is infected with the plague carrier's Plague Symptoms.

actions.name: Bile Spreader
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage, and the target is infected with the plague carrier's Plague Symptoms. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Absorption
traits.desc: When the abomination kills a creature that is neither a construct nor undead, it absorbs the corpse into its body and regains 20 Hit Points.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The abomination can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The abomination can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The abomination makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Large or smaller creature, the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) and the abomination uses Engulf on the Grappled creature.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc: The abomination engulfs a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it. Until the grapple ends the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the abomination. If the abomination moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The abomination can have only one creature engulfed at a time. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. The engulfed creature repeats the save at the start of each of the abomination's turns Success: The target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

sb.name: Psychophant
sb.languages: Common (only repeats phrases it has heard)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The psychophant makes two Psychic Grasp attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Grasp
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage and the target has the Immobilized condition (Wisdom saving throw DC 14 save ends).

actions.name: Final Scream (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 40 (9d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). Success: Half damage, and the target is immune to this psychophant's Final Scream for 24 hours.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.desc: The psychophant shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid it has seen or reverts to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form.

bonus_actions.name: Life Siphon
bonus_actions.desc: The psychophant deals 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage to a creature it damaged this turn with Psychic Grasp, then regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport
bonus_actions.desc: The psychophant teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. It can bring one creature Immobilized by its Psychic Grasp, which teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the psychophant's destination space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The maunder makes one Grasp or Bite attack against each creature within its reach. Alternatively, it makes two Eye Beam attacks.

actions.name: Grasp
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). The maunder has countless hands and can grapple any number of creatures.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft., one creature Grappled by the maunder. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage. A Dazed target that is Grappled by the maunder is Helpless against this attack.

actions.name: Eye Beam
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Babble
bonus_actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the maunder that can hear it. Failure: 7 (2d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 83 (15d8 + 15) plus 83 (15d8 + 15) per player character

traits.name: Canny Defense
traits.desc: While the Queen of Thieves is wearing light or no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Intelligence modifier (included above).

traits.name: Masked Identity
traits.desc: The Queen of Thieves is immune to any effect that would sense her emotions or read her thoughts, as well as any divination spell that she refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain her intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Memory Thief
traits.desc: Creatures are not aware when the Queen of Thieves reads their thoughts or imposes the Charmed condition on them. Additionally, when a spell cast by the her that causes creatures to become Charmed ends, she can make affected creatures lose their memories. Each creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw or forget up to 8 hours of the time spent Charmed by her. These memories can be restored with a [[Tools/Spells/Heal|Heal]] spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Vexing Aura
traits.desc:
The Queen of Thieves projects a 30-foot Emanation of bewitching magic. At the start of each of her turns, she can choose the aura's effect, which applies to creatures of her choice in the Emanation:

- **Enchanting Presence.** A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation has the Charmed condition until it ends its turn outside the Emanation. If she deals damage to the creature, the condition ends, and that creature is immune to her Enchanting Presence for 24 hours.
- **Mocking Laughter.** A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: The Queen of Thieves always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On her turn, she can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, she takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: +3 Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (1d8 + 8) Piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Cutting Words
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 120 feet of the Queen of Thieves. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next D20 Test it makes before the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Dash
actions.desc: The Queen of Thieves moves up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Misdirection (1/Round)
actions.desc: The Queen of Thieves becomes Invisible and teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 60 feet. At the same time, an illusory double of her appears where she was standing. The illusory double, as well as the Invisible condition, end if the Queen of Thieves attacks or casts a spell, or after 1 minute.

actions.name: Resistance Resistance
actions.desc: The Queen of Thieves chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. She can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

actions.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
actions.desc:
The Queen of Thieves casts one of the following spells, requiring no Verbal or Somatic components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18, +10 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|Disguise Self]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included above), [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|Suggestion]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Monster|Charm Monster]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|Dimension Door]], [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|Dominate Person]], [[Tools/Spells/Gaseous Form|Gaseous Form]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Invisibility|Greater Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|Hypnotic Pattern]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|Major Image]] (level 4 version), [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|Mirror Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]], [[Tools/Spells/Sleep|Sleep]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Feeblemind|Feeblemind]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Suggestion|Mass Suggestion]], [[Tools/Spells/Project Image|Project Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Seeming|Seeming]]

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 45 (6d8 + 24) plus 45 (6d8 + 24) per player character

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The Rat Crown-Prince has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Verminous Aura
traits.desc: The Rat Crown-Prince emits a 30-foot Emanation of verminous contamination. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: The Rat Crown-Prince always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On his turn, The Rat Crown Prince can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Rat Crown-Prince takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Contaminated Bite (1/Round)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Delerium-Infused Blades
actions.desc:
Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Necrotic damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of the Rat Crown-Prince's choice (he can't select the same option more than once per round):

- **Poison.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 18 (4d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute (save ends). Success: Half damage only.
- **Acid Burn.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 10 (3d6) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (3d6 Acid). Success: Half damage only.
- **Mindkiller.** If the target is maintaining Concentration on a spell, it takes an extra 25 (5d10) Psychic damage unless it chooses to end its Concentration.

actions.name: Call Ratlings (1/Round)
actions.desc: 2d4 Ratling Warriors appear, burrowing up from below unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of the Rat Crown-Prince. The warriors have 1 Hit Point each and remain until killed.

actions.name: Meld into Shadow (1/Round)
actions.desc: The Rat Crown-Prince has the Invisible condition until he makes an attack.

actions.name: Swift Stride
actions.desc: The Rat Crown-Prince moves up to his Speed.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The Rat Crown-Prince chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. The Rat Crown-Prince can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

sb.name: Rat God
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 116 (8d12 + 64) plus 116 (8d12 + 64) per player character

traits.name: Mass of Tails
traits.desc: Ranged attacks against the Rat God from further than 60 feet away have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Verminous Aura
traits.desc: The Rat God is surrounded by a 60-foot radius of vermin, pouring out of it and spilling over into the area as they claw and gnash. The area is Difficult Terrain and a creature that starts its turn in the area takes 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: The Rat God always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On its turn, the Rat God can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Rat God takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Flail of Skulls.** Melee Attack Roll: +16, reach 15 ft. Hit: 28 (3d12 + 9) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Burning condition (3d6 Acid).
- **Great Feeding.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 26, each creature within 60 feet of the Rat God. Failure: 10 (3d6) Piercing damage, and the target has the Sickened condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The Rat God regains Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt to all targets.

actions.name: Rodent Rifts (1/Round)
actions.desc: The Rat God teleports to an unoccupied space within 120 feet. Each creature within 15 feet of the Rat God when it arrives is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 26. Failure: 28 (8d6) Necrotic damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the Rat God.

actions.name: Warp Bolt
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 22, one creature the Rat God can see within 120 feet. Failure: 23 (4d12) Necrotic damage, and the target suffers a Contamination level.

actions.name: Infernal Chittering
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 26, one creature the Rat God can see within 60 feet that can hear the Rat God. Failure: 18 (4d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The Rat God chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Rat God can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

sb.name: Rat King
sb.speed: 30 ft., burrow 15 ft., climb 30 ft., swim 30 ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Rat King makes two Tail Whip attacks, then uses Psychic Blast or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Tail Whip
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 33 (8d6 + 5) Psychic damage. Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target has the Dazed and Slowed conditions until the end of the Rat King's next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Blast (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 21 (6d6) Psychic damage, and the target is Jinxed 1d10 (save ends).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The Rat King casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Evard'S Black Tentacles|Evard's Black Tentacles]], [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|Telekinesis]]

sb.name: Rat Prince
sb.gear: Hand Crossbow, Leather Armor, Quiver, Bolt (10), Shortsword (2)

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The Rat Prince has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The Rat Prince has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the Rat Prince's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Rat Prince makes three attacks: two with his Shortswords and one with his Contaminated Bite.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Contaminated Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. Failure: The target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Ratling Cunning
bonus_actions.desc: The Rat Prince takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

reactions.name: Sacrificial Pawn
reactions.desc: Trigger: The Rat Prince is targeted by an attack or spell that targets only him. Response: The Rat Prince redirects the attack or spell to another ratling within 5 feet of him, causing the ratling to become the target instead.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The ratling has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The ratling has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ratling's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ratling makes three Repeating Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Bite

Failure or Success: A [[Tools/Spells/Lesser Restoration|Lesser Restoration]] spell ends the disease early.

actions.name: Metastasize

Failure: The target has one of the following conditions (the ratling's choice): Addled, Clumsy, or Enfeebled (save ends). The condition immediately ends and is replace by a new condition if the ratling uses Metastasize on the target again. Failure or Success: 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Rampant Sickness
bonus_actions.desc: The ratling spreads its Infection from an infected target to another creature adjacent to that target.

sb.name: Ravenous Flora
sb.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Tremorsense 300 ft., passive Perception 12

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 42 (4d10 + 20) plus 42 (4d10 + 20) per player character

traits.name: Writhing Aura
traits.desc: The ground within 30 feet of the ravenous flora is filled with plant roots and becomes Difficult Terrain. A creature that starts its turn in the aura takes 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

traits.name: Poison Ivy
traits.desc: If the ravenous flora would take Poison damage, it instead takes no damage and regains Hit Points equal to the Poison damage it would have received.

actions.name: The ravenous flora always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On its turn, the ravenous flora can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the ravenous flora takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Bite.** Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and the ravenous flora can't Bite another target.
- **Spit Acid.** Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (2d4 Acid). While Burning, the target has the Blinded condition.
- **Swallow.** The ravenous flora makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it has Grappled. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. The swallowed target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover from attacks and effects outside the flora, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The flora can have up to four targets swallowed at a time. If the flora takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land with the Prone condition in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of it. If the flora dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Hypnotic Pollen (1/Round)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the ravenous flora. Failure: 9 (2d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends). While Weakened, the target must spend all of its movement on each of its turns to move directly toward the ravenous flora. During this movement, the target ignores Difficult Terrain caused by the flora's Writhing Aura.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The ravenous flora chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The ravenous flora can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The ghoul has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the ghoul's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Rancid Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aggressive
bonus_actions.desc: The ghoul moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile creature it can see.

sb.name: Reality Cyst
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The reality cyst is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Unhinged Reality
traits.desc: The reality cyst emits a 120-foot Emanation of unhinged reality. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation is subjected to the following effect. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target has the Immobilized condition until it leaves the Emanation. While Immobilized, the target believes itself to be in an altered and confused environment of shifting forms, and can't see or hear anything else. The target does not perceive itself to be stationary, and instead believes it is walking through a bizarre landscape. It can take an action on its turn to repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the creature succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to the reality cyst's Unhinged Reality for 24 hours.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The reality cyst doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Psychic Whip
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition until the end of the reality cyst's next turn. The reality cyst can target a creature Immobilized by its Unhinged Reality with this attack even if the creature has Total Cover.

bonus_actions.name: Feed
bonus_actions.desc: Each creature Immobilized by Unhinged Reality takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. The reality cyst regains Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt, and its Hit Point Maximum increases by the same amount.

reactions.name: Fracture
reactions.desc: Trigger: The reality cyst takes damage. Response—Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the reality cyst. Failure: The target has the Addled condition (save ends).

sb.name: Reautomata
sb.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.desc: If damage reduces the reautomata to 0 Hit Points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is from a Critical Hit. On a success, the reautomata drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The reautomata's Long Jump is up to 50 feet and its High Jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The reautomata makes two Arm Blade attacks and one Entrapping Rend attack.

actions.name: Arm Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 5 feet away from the reautomata and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Entrapping Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft., one Prone target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the reautomata can't make Entrapping Rend attacks against another target.

bonus_actions.name: Aggressive
bonus_actions.desc: The reautomata moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile creature it can see. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attack action.

sb.name: Reautomata Wrecker
sb.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The reautomata deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The reautomata makes one Drill attack and one Wrecking Ball attack.

actions.name: Drill
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Wrecking Ball
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 20 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The target has the Dazed condition (save ends) and the Prone condition.

actions.name: Destructive Rampage (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The reautomata moves up to its Speed in a straight line, moving through the space of any Medium or smaller creature on its path. The first time its enters each creature's space during this move, it can make a Drill or Wrecking Ball attack against that creature.

bonus_actions.name: Overdrive Engine (1/Day; Bloodied Only)
bonus_actions.desc: The reautomata's Destructive Rampage recharges, and it gains Immunity to all damage and conditions until the end of its next turn. For the duration, the reautomata automatically succeeds on all saving throws and Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution-based ability checks and has Advantage on attack rolls. It can't be forced to move or affected by spells of level 8 or lower unless it chooses to be. Features and effects that ignore Resistances and Immunities, such as a Vorpal Weapon, don't function against the reautomata unless those effects are caused by a level 9 spell or an artifact. At the end of its next turn, the reautomata dies and explodes. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the reautomata when it dies. Failure: 20 (8d4) Acid damage plus 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: Ascendant Transformation
traits.desc: When Vladimir von Drakken drops to 0 Hit Points, his body explodes in a shower of gore and he reappears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet as Ascendant Vladimir von Drakken. His Initiative doesn't change.

traits.name: Aura of Dread
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Vladimir von Drakken takes 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Bloodthirsty
traits.desc: Vladimir von Drakken has Advantage on attack rolls against a target with the Bloodied or Bleeding condition.

traits.name: Daywalker
traits.desc: Vladimir von Drakken doesn't possess any Vampire Weaknesses from the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Vladimir von Drakken regains 30 Hit Points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 Hit Point remaining.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Vladimir von Drakken can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On his turn, Vladimir von Drakken can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Vladimir von Drakken takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Bloodmourne.** Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) Force damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4). In addition, Vladimir von Drakken can apply one of the following martial maneuvers to the target:
- **Advance.** Vladimir von Drakken pushes the target 15 feet, then moves up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target without provoking Opportunity Attack action.
- **Hamstring.** The target has the Immobilized condition until the end of its next turn.
- **Overpower.** The target has the Staggered condition until the end of its next turn.
- **Claws.** Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20).

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 49 (14d6) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (DC 20 Constitution save ends). Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

actions.name: Dominate (1/Round)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature Vladimir von Drakken can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed, the target obeys Vladimir von Drakken's commands and can't take Reactions. Failure by 5 or More: The Charmed condition lasts 24 hours or until Vladimir von Drakken is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. Success: The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll against Vladimir von Drakken.

actions.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from Vladimir von Drakken. Failure: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from Vladimir von Drakken and has the Prone condition. Failure or Success: Before or after using this Epic Action, Vladimir von Drakken can move up to half his Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Shadow Step (2/Round)
actions.desc: Vladimir von Drakken teleports to an unoccupied space he can see within 60 feet that is in Dim Light or Darkness. He has Advantage on the next melee attack he makes before the end of this round.

actions.name: Shape-Shift (1/Round)
actions.desc: Vladimir von Drakken shape-shifts into a Tiny bat (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist (Speed 5 ft., Fly Speed 20 ft. [hover]), or he returns to his vampire form. Anything he is wearing transforms with him. While in bat or mist form, Vladimir von Drakken can't speak. His game statistics, other than his size and Speed, are unchanged, but he can't use Epic Actions other than Shape-Shift and Epic Resistance. While in mist form, Vladimir von Drakken can't speak or manipulate objects, and loses his Aura of Dread. He is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. He has Resistance to all damage.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: Vladimir von Drakken chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

reactions.name: Spell-Reflecting Strike
reactions.desc: Trigger: Vladimir von Drakken makes a successful saving throw against a spell, or a spell attack misses him. Response: Vladimir von Drakken can choose another creature (including the spellcaster) he can see within 120 feet of him. The spell targets the chosen creature instead of Vladimir von Drakken. If the spell forces a saving throw, the chosen creature makes its own save. If the spell was an attack, the attack roll is rerolled against the chosen creature.

sb.name: Ripper
sb.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Dismemberment
traits.desc: Creatures killed by attacks made by the ripper can't be restored to life except by a [[Tools/Spells/Resurrection|Resurrection]] spell or similar magic.

traits.name: Feed on Fear
traits.desc: Frightened creatures have the Helpless and Defenseless conditions against attacks made by the ripper.

traits.name: Insensitive to Pain
traits.desc: Critical Hits against the ripper become normal hits.

actions.name: Whirling Bonesaw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage, and the ripper can immediately make another Whirling Bonesaw attack against the same target. This attack ignores [[Tools/Spells/Resistance|Resistance]] and Immunity to Slashing damage.

actions.name: Gory Display (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature that can see the ripper. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends). While Frightened, the target's Speed becomes 0 and can't increase.

reactions.name: Unstoppable Lurch
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature deals damage to the ripper. Response: The ripper moves up to half its Speed toward that creature without provoking Opportunity Attack action. If the ripper ends this movement within reach of the creature, it gains Advantage on its next attack roll against the creature.

traits.name: Academy Rings (1/Day)
traits.desc: River can cast a spell from Spellcasting without expending a use of it.

actions.name: Force Missile
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 120 ft. Hit: 28 (8d6) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
River casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|Detect Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Find Familiar|Find Familiar]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included above), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|Dimension Door]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Identify|Identify]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]] (level 4 version), [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Rary'S Telepathic Bond|Rary's Telepathic Bond]], [[Tools/Spells/Teleportation Circle|Teleportation Circle]]

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.desc: River casts [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|Misty Step]] using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

reactions.name: River's Contingency
reactions.desc: Trigger: River becomes Bloodied. Response: River casts [[Tools/Spells/Mislead|Mislead]] and teleports to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet.

traits.name: Death Strike
traits.desc: When the assassin reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, the creature immediately dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The assassin makes three Poison Weapon attacks.

actions.name: Poisoned Weapon
actions.desc:
Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage. Once per turn, the assassin can apply one of the following additional effects to the target:

- **Silent Scream.** Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target has the Bewildered condition (save ends). While Bewildered, the target is unable to speak.
- **Sap Strength.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition (save ends). While Poisoned, the target also has the Weakened condition.
- **Sluggish Sinews.** Strength Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target has the Dazed condition (save ends). While Dazed, the target also has the Slowed condition.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: The assassin takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.desc: When the knight dies, its soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in its chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: The knight is immune to the Contamination condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The knight makes three Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage if wielded with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Lay on Hands (3/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The knight touches another creature. The target regains 11 (2d8 + 2) Hit Points and is cured of one disease or the Poisoned condition.

reactions.name: Deny the Witch (3/Day)
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the knight can see within 60 feet of it casts a spell. Response: If the spell is level 3 or lower, the spell fails, but no resources are wasted.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.desc: When the monk dies, its soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in its chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: Sanctified Monk is immune to the Contamination condition.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While the monk is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier (included above).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The monk makes three Unarmed Strike attacks or five Dart attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 20/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Flame Step
bonus_actions.desc: The monk teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet that is in Bright Light. It gains Advantage on its next melee attack.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.desc: When the sanctified soul dies, its soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in its chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: The sanctified soul is immune to the Contamination condition.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) Bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Guiding Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 120 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The sanctified soul casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|Faerie Fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Flame Strike|Flame Strike]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Fire|Wall of Fire]]

reactions.name: Flash of Light
