reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the sanctified soul can see makes an attack roll. Response: The sanctified soul imposes Disadvantage on the attack roll.

sb.name: Sanguine Witch
sb.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical Darkness), passive Perception 15

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes two attacks and uses Feast, if available. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Blood Drain
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. The target has the Weakened condition (DC 15 Constitution save ends).

actions.name: Feast (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the vampire. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage plus 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The vampire regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The vampire casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included above)
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|Darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Fear|Fear]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|Hold Person]], [[Tools/Spells/Inflict Wounds|Inflict Wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Enfeeblement|Ray of Enfeeblement]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|Suggestion]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|Bestow Curse]], [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|Dominate Person]], [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|Hypnotic Pattern]], [[Tools/Spells/Vampiric Touch|Vampiric Touch]]

reactions.name: Arcane Denial
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the vampire can see within 60 feet casts a spell of level 3 or lower. Response—Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The spell fails, but no resources are wasted.

sb.name: Scrap Reautomata
sb.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Combustion
traits.desc: While the reautomata has the Burning condition, its Speed becomes 50 feet and its melee weapon attacks deal an extra 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The reautomata makes two attacks.

actions.name: Rusty Weapon
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Ignition (Recharges after a Short Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: The reautomata has the Burning condition (2d6 Fire).

sb.name: Sentient Planetoid
sb.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, thunder
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The sentient planetoid is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The sentient planetoid may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.desc: As an action, the sentient planetoid can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the sentient planetoid has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.desc: The sentient planetoid is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sentient planetoid's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Beyond Space and Time
traits.desc: The sentient planetoid always acts on Initiative count 20. Additionally, it can't be moved, teleported, or sent to another plane of existence against its will.

traits.name: Gravitational Pull
traits.desc: The sentient planetoid exerts its own force of gravity in a 100-foot Emanation. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation falls towards the sentient planetoid, taking falling damage as appropriate if it collides with the planetoid. A creature can make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The sentient planetoid is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The sentient planetoid has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sentient planetoid makes four attacks, only one of which can be an Unfathomable Knowledge attack.

actions.name: Unfathomable Knowledge
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +14, reach 5 ft. or range 250 ft. Hit: 39 (6d12) Psychic damage, and the target has the Addled and Weakened conditions until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Crashing Comet
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +14, range 150 ft. Hit: 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Burning condition (3d8 Fire).

actions.name: All-Knowing Magic (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The sentient planetoid casts any spell of level 5 or lower, using Intelligence as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22, +14 to spell attacks).

traits.name: Instinctive Ambusher
traits.desc: At the start of the sewer thing's first turn of each combat, if the sewer thing attacks a creature, it can make one additional Tendril Lash attack as part of its Multiattack action.

traits.name: Poison Absorption
traits.desc: Whenever the sewer thing takes Poison damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Poison damage dealt.

traits.name: Toxic Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the sewer thing is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: 5 (1d10) Poison damage.

traits.name: Unexpected Appearance
traits.desc: If the sewer thing is motionless at the start of combat, it has Advantage on its Initiative roll. Additionally, if a creature hasn't observed the sewer thing move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the sewer thing is animate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sewer thing makes two attacks and uses Engulf.

actions.name: Tendril Lash
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 30 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Reel
actions.desc: The sewer thing pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 20 feet straight toward it.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc: The sewer thing engulfs a Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet of it that is Grappled by it. The grapple ends. The target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and is subjected to the following effect at the start of each of the sewer thing's turns. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 11 (2d10) Poison damage plus 11 (2d10) Acid damage. If the sewer thing moves, the target moves with it. The sewer thing can have up to four creatures engulfed at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check, landing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the sewer thing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The manticore makes two Claw attacks and one Stinger attack

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. If the manticore flies 30+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition and the manticore can make a Bite attack against it as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 20 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 24 (7d6) Necrotic damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target also gains one Contamination level. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Wing Shards (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the manticore (flying creatures have Disadvantage). Failure: 28 (8d6) Piercing damage, and if the target is flying, it has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Holy Weapons
traits.desc: When the cavalier hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 9 (2d8) Radiant damage (included in the attack).

traits.name: Skilled Rider
traits.desc: While mounted, the cavalier can force an attack that targets its mount to target the cavalier instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The cavalier makes two attacks.

actions.name: Lance
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7 (with Disadvantage against a target within 5 feet), reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Force damage plus 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Force damage plus 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Summon Steed (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The cavalier magically summons a Griffon, which appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the cavalier and obeys its commands. The steed takes its turn immediately before or after the cavalier. It remains until it or the cavalier dies, or the cavalier dismisses it as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Holy Weapons
traits.desc: When the paladin hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 9 (2d8) Radiant damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The paladin makes two attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Force damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) Force damage if wielded with two hands, plus 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Force damage plus 9 (2d8) Radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Lay on Hands (3/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The paladin touches another creature. The target regains 11 (2d8 + 2) Hit Points and is cured of one disease or the Poisoned condition.

reactions.name: Deny the Witch (3/Day)
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the paladin can see within 60 feet casts a spell. Response: If the spell is level 3 or lower, the spell fails, but no resources are wasted.

traits.name: For the Flame! (3/Day)
traits.desc: The recruit can take an additional Multiattack action on its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The recruit makes two attacks using its Longsword or Shortbow in any combination.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: The target is pushed 5 feet away from the recruit and has the Staggered condition (save ends).

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Trigger: The recruit is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The recruit adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

sb.name: Silver Order Squire
sb.gear: Quiver, Shield, Shortbow, Shortsword, Studded Leather Armor

traits.name: For the Flame! (1/Day)
traits.desc: The squire can take an additional Multiattack action on its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The squire makes two attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Helping Hand
actions.desc: The squire grants a creature within 5 feet of them Valor (1d4) until the end of that creature's next turn.

reactions.name: Look Out!
reactions.desc: Trigger: An ally within 5 feet of the squire is hit by an attack. Response: The squire takes the attack's damage instead.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Chillsteel Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage. Critical Hit: The target has the Frozen condition (DC 10).

bonus_actions.name: Steady Aim
bonus_actions.desc: The skeleton archer grants itself Advantage on its next ranged attack roll this turn. It can use this Bonus Action only if it hasn't moved during this turn, and after it uses this Bonus Action, its Speed becomes 0 and can't increase until the end of this turn.

actions.name: Fire Lance
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) Fire damage, and the target has the Burning condition (1d10 Fire).

actions.name: Shocking Arc
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Lightning damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: The target has the Shocked condition (save ends).

actions.name: Thunder Blast (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from the skeleton mage. Failure: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the skeleton mage. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport
bonus_actions.desc: The skeleton mage teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

actions.name: Poison-Tipped Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Shield Slam
bonus_actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature within 5 feet of the skeleton soldier. Failure: The target is pushed 5 feet away from the skeleton soldier and has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Amorphous Form
traits.desc: The skin crawler can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skin crawler makes two Claw attacks and one Bind attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Bind
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and the skin crawler can't Bind another target.

bonus_actions.name: Crush and Consume
bonus_actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature Grappled by the skin crawler. Failure: 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the skin crawler regains an equal number of Hit Points. If this damage kills the target, the skin crawler assumes its form. The skin crawler's game statistics are the same in each form. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The skinwing has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the skinwing's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Disturbing Bleating
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the skinwing is subjected to the following effect. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: The target has the Staggered condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to the Disturbing Bleating of all skinwings for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skinwing makes one Bite attack and one Talons attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skretch makes two attacks.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spittle
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 120/300 ft., one target directly underneath the skretch. Hit: 15 (6d4) Acid damage.

actions.name: Expel Waste (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 10-foot radius Sphere directly beneath the skretch. Failure: 20 (8d4) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d4 Acid). Each time the target takes damage from this condition, it must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or gain one Contamination level. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the skull remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary humanoid skull.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Disparaging Remarks
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the skull can see within 10 feet. Failure: 5 (2d4) Psychic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Guiding Words
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature the skull can see within 10 feet makes an ability check. Response: The target can roll 1d4 and add the result to that check.

sb.name: Spell Leech
sb.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Aquatic Camouflage
traits.desc: The leech has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

traits.name: Spell Glands
traits.desc: The leech has a spell gland, which can store up to ten levels of spells. When encountered, roll 1d10 to determine how many spell levels it has stored.

actions.name: Attach
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 0 ft. Hit: The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Failure: The leech is still detached, but the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Spell Drain
bonus_actions.desc: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature. The attached creature is subjected to the following effect. Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 13. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Bewildered condition until the start of the leech's next turn. If the target has spell slots, the leech drains one randomly determined spell slot which can be no higher than level 3. It then fills its spell glands with the same number of spell levels.

bonus_actions.name: Arcane Transfusion
bonus_actions.desc: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one level worth of spells in its Spell Glands. The leech empties any number of spell levels from its Spell Glands, and the creature it is attached to regains an equal number of spell levels worth of spell slots.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The dreg climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Spiny Body
traits.desc: Any creature grappling the dreg or Grappled by it takes 5 (1d10) Piercing damage at the end of that creature's turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dreg makes three Spike attacks.

actions.name: Spike
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft., or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. Critical Hit: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target gains one level of Contamination.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The star warden is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The star warden may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.desc: As an action, the star warden can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the star warden has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.desc: The star warden is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the star warden's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Cosmic Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the star warden is subjected to the following effect. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target is hurled through time and space, witnessing every moment of existence in a single second. It takes 17 (5d6) Psychic damage and is teleported to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

traits.name: Lords of Time and Space
traits.desc: When the star warden is reduced to 0 Hit Points, roll a d20. On a 1 or 20, the star warden regains all of its Hit Points and another creature of its choice within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The star warden makes two attacks.

actions.name: Staff of Stars
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60/120 ft. Hit: 22 (5d6 + 4) Radiant damage plus 10 (3d6) Force damage.

actions.name: Nebulae Grasp
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the star warden can teleport the target to an unoccupied space the star warden can see within 120 feet.

actions.name: Stardust
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d6 + 4) Radiant damage and the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Radiant).

bonus_actions.name: The Cold Void of Space
bonus_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature within 120 feet of the star warden that teleported this turn. Failure: The target has the Frozen condition. Success: 10 (3d6) Cold damage.

reactions.name: Outside Time and Space
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature hits the star warden with an attack. Response: The star warden switches places with another creature within 30 feet, and the attack hits that creature instead.

sb.name: Stitcher
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Hold Still, Please
traits.desc: The stitcher has Advantage on attack rolls against a Grappled, Immobilized, or Slowed creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The stitcher makes two Scissorhand attacks and one Sewing Needle attack. It can replace any of these attacks with Attach Limb.

actions.name: Scissorhand
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

actions.name: Sewing Needle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target has a body part bound and sewn up (stitcher's choice):

actions.name: Eyes
actions.desc: The target has the Blinded condition.

actions.name: Mouth
actions.desc: The target cannot speak and cannot cast spells with a verbal component.

actions.name: Limbs
actions.desc: The target has the Restrained condition. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to remove the threads with a successful DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check, ending the effect. Failure: The threads are removed but the target takes 11 (2d10) Slashing damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target takes 11 (2d10) Slashing damage and the threads aren't removed.

actions.name: Attach Limb
actions.desc:
Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the stitcher can see within 10 feet (Grappled, Slowed, Restrained, Incapacitated, and Immobilized creatures have Disadvantage). Failure: The target makes a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw at the start of each of its turns. On a success, it controls the limb until the start of its next turn. Otherwise, the limb is uncontrolled for the same duration. The target suffers one of the following effects depending on the attached limb:

- **Head.** While controlled, the target has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma-based D20 Tests. While uncontrolled, the target can control its action or its movement on its turn, but the head controls the other. On a failure by 5 or more, the head chooses which to control instead of the target.
- **Arm.** While controlled, the target can take an extra action on its turn, choosing from the Attack (one weapon attack only) or Utilize actions. While uncontrolled, the extra arm makes one melee weapon attack against the target at the start of its turn. The arm has a +9 attack bonus and deals 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage on a hit.
- **Leg.** While controlled, the target can take an extra action on its turn, choosing from the Dash or Disengage actions. While uncontrolled, the leg forces the target to move up to its Speed in a random direction at the start of its turn. If this movement forces the target toward a hazard or precipice, the host can repeat the saving throw. On a successful save, it stops its movement and has the Prone condition before entering the hazard. An attached limb can be attacked (AC 20, 20 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). A creature within 5 feet can take an action to remove the limb with a successful DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check or DC 15 Strength check. When removed by any means other than a successful Wisdom (Medicine) check, the target takes 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage and has the Bleeding condition (4d4).

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: The troll is immune to the Shocked condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll makes two Claw attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace its Bite attack with Hurl Lightning if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Staggered condition until the end of the troll's next turn.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Lightning damage, and lightning leaps from the target to a different creature of the troll's choice that it can see within 10 feet of the target. The second creature takes 18 (4d8) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Hurl Lightning (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The troll hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 300 feet of it. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Failure: 18 (4d8) Lightning damage and has the Shocked condition until the end of the troll's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 57 (6d10 + 24) plus 57 (6d10 + 24) per player character

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The striga has Advantage on melee attack rolls against a creature with the Bloodied condition.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The striga is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. It may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Necrotic Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the Striga takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The striga regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the striga takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The striga can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: The striga has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: The striga always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On its turn, the striga can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the striga takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Necrotic Bite (1/Round)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point Maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the striga regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 15 ft. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Delerium Healing
actions.desc: The striga touches a delerium shard and regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the striga has used a delerium shard in this way, it can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

actions.name: Blood Howl (1/Round)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the striga that can hear it. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Jinxed (1d6) and Immobilized conditions (save ends both). Success: Half damage, and the target is immune to the striga's Blood Howl for 24 hours.

actions.name: Charge
actions.desc: The striga moves up to 40 feet in a straight line, moving through the spaces of other creatures. Each creature whose space the striga passes through is subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18. Failure: The target is pushed 10 feet away from the striga and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The striga chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The striga can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

reactions.name: Retaliation
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature within 15 feet of the striga deals Radiant damage to it. Response: The striga makes a Claws attack against that creature.

sb.name: Swarm of Contaminated Insects
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Contaminated Bites
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 0 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, or 3 (1d6) Necrotic damage if the swarm has the Bloodied condition. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10. Failure: The target gains one Contamination level.

sb.name: Swarm of Ratlings
sb.speed: 30 ft., burrow 15 ft., climb 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small ratling. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Chittering Mass
traits.desc: The swarm has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature in its space.

traits.name: Scampering Survivors
traits.desc: When the swarm is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it leaves behind 1d4 Ratling Warriors in its space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The swarm makes one Bite attack against each creature in its space.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 0 ft. Hit: 28 (8d6) Piercing damage, or 14 (4d6) Piercing damage if the swarm has the Bloodied condition. If the target is a creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14).

bonus_actions.name: Scurrying Horde
bonus_actions.desc: The swarm takes the Dash action.

sb.name: Tanker
sb.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Chemical Stench
traits.desc: A creature other than a Construct or Undead that starts its turn within 10 feet of the tanker is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target has the Sickened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to the Chemical Stench of all tankers for 1 hour.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: The tanker is immune to the Burning condition (Acid only).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tanker makes two Slam or Chemical Glob attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Chemical Glob
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 60/120 ft. Hit: 14 (4d6) Acid, Cold, or Poison damage (tanker's choice).

actions.name: Chemical Spray (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc:
Each creature in a 30-foot Cone is subjected to one of the following effects of the tanker's choice:

- **Sulfuric Acid.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 25 (10d4) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (4d4 Acid). Success: Half damage only.
- **Liquid Nitrogen.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage, and the target has the Frozen condition (DC 14). Success: Half damage only.
- **Chlorine Gas.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 14 (4d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition (save ends). While Poisoned, the target has the Blinded condition. Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Malleable
traits.desc: The dreg can move through a space as narrow as 6 inches wide without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dreg makes two Tentacle Slap attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle Slap
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 15 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Constricting Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 15 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition, takes 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the dreg can't make Constricting Tentacle attacks.

sb.name: The Algorithm
sb.damage_immunities: cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 305 (15d20 + 150) plus 300 (15d20 + 150) per player character

traits.name: Electronic Data Network
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Algorithm takes 21 (6d6) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The Algorithm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Predictive Analytics
traits.desc: At the end of each of the Algorithm's turns, it rolls 1d20 for each player character fighting it. The Algorithm can replace any D20 Test made by it or a creature it can see with one of these predictive rolls. It must choose to do so before the roll, and it can replace a roll in this way only once per turn. Each predictive roll can be used only once. Any unused predictive rolls are lost at the start of the Algorithm's next turn.

actions.name: The Algorithm always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On its turn, the Algorithm can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Algorithm takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Wire.** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 26, one creature the Algorithm can see within 60 feet. Failure: 21 (2d10 + 10) Force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). The Algorithm can grapple up to six creatures at a time.
- **Algorithmic Manipulation.** Strength Saving Throw: DC 26, one Huge or smaller creature or object the Algorithm can see within 120 feet. Failure: The Algorithm moves the target up to 30 feet in any direction, and the target has the Restrained condition. If the Algorithm lifts the target into the air, it is suspended there. The target remains held until the Algorithm releases it (no action required), uses this Epic Action again, or has the Incapacitated condition.
- **Deatomization.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 26, one creature or object the Algorithm can see within 300 feet. Failure: 65 (10d12) Necrotic damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it dies and its body is reduced to atoms. Failure: Half damage.

actions.name: Reprogram (1/Round)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 26, one creature Grappled by the algorithm. Failure: 55 (10d10) Piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it dies and its brain is replaced with mechanical components. The target reanimates at the start of its next turn as a Construct under the Algorithm's control. It resembles the original creature, but its eyes glow with synthetic green light, and its body is covered in protruding wires, metal scraps, and glowing tubes.

actions.name: Assuming Direct Control (1/Round)
actions.desc: The Algorithm targets a Construct within 120 feet and immediately enters and takes control of it. The Algorithm can still use its Epic Actions as normal and replaces the Construct's game statistics with its own, except the Construct's Hit Points. When the Construct is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Algorithm reemerges in an unoccupied space within 15 feet of it.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The Algorithm chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Algorithm can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

actions.name: Spellcasting (1/Round)
actions.desc:
The Algorithm casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 27):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Fabricate|Fabricate]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|Wall of Force]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Antimagic Field|Antimagic Field]], [[Tools/Spells/Prismatic Wall|Prismatic Wall]], [[Tools/Spells/Reverse Gravity|Reverse Gravity]]
- **1/Year:** [[Tools/Spells/Wish|Wish]]

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 87 (6d20 + 24) plus 87 (6d20 + 24) per player character

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The Duchess can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Aura of the Deep
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 60 feet of the Duchess takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.desc: As an action, a creature can touch one of the Duchess's Delerium shards to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once a Delerium shard restores Hit Points in this way, it can't do so again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The Dutchess is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The Dutchess may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The Duchess has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Moisture Regeneration
traits.desc: The Duchess regains 20 Hit Points at the start of each of her turns if she is submerged at least partially in water. She dies only if she starts her turn at 0 Hit Points and does not regenerate.

actions.name: The Duchess always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On her turn, the Duchess can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Duchess takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 20 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). The Duchess can have up to four creatures Grappled at a time. At the start of each of its turns until the grapple ends, the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: The target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: One Large or smaller object held or creature Grappled by the Duchess is thrown up to 60 feet in a direction of the Duchess's choice and has the Prone condition. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the Prone condition.

actions.name: Deep Domination (1/Round)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature The Duchess can see. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition. The target is under the Duchess's control and can't take Reactions. The Duchess and the target can communicate telepathically over any distance. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a failure, it gains one Contamination level. Once every 24 hours, if the creature is at least 1 mile away from the Duchess, it can repeat the saving throw. If the target undergoes a Monstrous Transformation, it becomes a Deep Dreg Warrior, a Deep Knight, or a Deep Siren, and is forever in thrall to the Duchess.

actions.name: Call of the Deep (1/Round)
actions.desc: The Duchess calls forth up to five Deep Dregs or one Deep Knight. The creatures appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of the Duchess and remain until destroyed. The creatures act after the Duchess on the same Initiative count and are under her control.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The Duchess chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. The Duchess can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
actions.desc:
The Duchess casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Dream|Dream]], [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|Polymorph]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Chain Lightning|Chain Lightning]], [[Tools/Spells/Control Water|Control Water]], [[Tools/Spells/Hypnotic Pattern|Hypnotic Pattern]], [[Tools/Spells/Project Image|Project Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|Telekinesis]], Acid Rain See Chemist., Biohazard, Controlled Mutation, Storm of Contamination, [[Tools/Spells/Weave The Elder Sign|Weave the Elder Sign]]

reactions.name: Sacrificial Pawn
reactions.desc: Trigger: The Duchess takes damage from an attack. Response: The Duchess chooses an ally or a creature Charmed by her to take the attack's damage instead.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 125 (7d20 + 49) plus 125 (7d20 + 49) per player character

traits.name: Alluring Aura
traits.desc: The Whispered Promise projects a 30-foot Emanation of beguiling enchantment. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation has the Charmed condition for 1 hour. Each time the creature takes damage other than Psychic damage, it makes a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the Charmed condition ends for that creature, and it is immune to the Alluring Aura of the Whispered Promise for 24 hours.

traits.name: Change Shape
traits.desc: The Whispered Promise has no true form and chooses how they manifest to each creature (no action required). Their form can be anything they wish; they can appear like a creature, object, or even as a multisensory representation of an abstract concept. They can appear to be any form that is Large or smaller, but their game statistics are the same in each form.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.desc: The Whispered Promise is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions or read their thoughts, as well as any divination spell that they refuse. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the Whispered Promise's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Glibness
traits.desc: When they make a Charisma (Deception) check, the Whispered Promise treats any roll of 14 or less on the d20 as 15.

traits.name: Unravelling Resolve
traits.desc: Creatures grappled by the Whispered Promise can't benefit from Resistance and Immunity to Psychic damage or the Charmed condition.

actions.name: The Whispered Promise always takes their turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On their turn, the Whispered Promise can use their movement and interaction as normal. However, they do not take an action or Bonus Action on their turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Whispered Promise takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Tendril.** Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 10 ft. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) Force damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 25). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
- **Whispers (1/Round).** Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 25. one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target is Dazed (save ends). Success: Half damage. Failure by five or more: Double damage, and the target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Promises (1/Round)
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target is Jinxed (1d10) (save ends). Success: Half damage. Failure by 5 or more: Double damage, and the target becomes cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain Hit Points and gains no benefits from taking a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Unfettered Glide
actions.desc: The Whispered Promise moves up to their Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Dominate (1/Round)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature the Whispered Promise can see within 300 feet. Failure: The creature has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn. While Charmed, the target obeys the Whispered Promise's commands and can't take Reactions. Failure by 5 or More: The Charmed condition instead lasts for 24 hours or until the Whispered Promise is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Each time the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. Success: The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll against the Whispered Promise.

actions.name: Epic Resistances
actions.desc: The Whispered Promise chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on them. The Whispered Promise can use this action even if they would otherwise be unable to take actions, their actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters their game statistics.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics; 1/Round)
actions.desc:
The Whispered Promise casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|Suggestion]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|Dimension Door]], [[Tools/Spells/Dream|Dream]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|Major Image (level 4 version)]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Monster|Dominate Monster]], [[Tools/Spells/Mass Suggestion|Mass Suggestion]], [[Tools/Spells/Project Image|Project Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]]
- **1/Year:** [[Tools/Spells/Wish|Wish]]

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 205 (10d20 + 100) plus 205 (10d20 + 100) per player character

traits.name: Delerium Storm Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the World Ender takes 21 (6d6) Lightning damage and is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24. Failure: The target gains one Contamination level.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The World Ender is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Mutations Abound
traits.desc: A creature that gains a Contamination level from the World Ender's Delerium Storm Aura must roll 2d6 and take the lower result to determine if they mutate. Whenever a creature within the aura gains a mutation, that creature must roll twice on the Mutations table and gains both mutations.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If the World Ender is destroyed, it regains all of its Hit Points in 1 hour unless a [[Tools/Spells/Wish|Wish]] spell is used to prevent it from rejuvenating. This is a stressful use of the [[Tools/Spells/Wish|Wish]] spell.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The World Ender deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Unbound Arcana
traits.desc: Whenever the World Ender is the target of a spell, an Arcane Anomalies is triggered on the caster.

actions.name: The World Ender always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On its turn, the World Ender can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the World Ender takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Necrotic Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 37 (5d10 + 10) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Bite (1/Round)
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 26 (3d10 + 10) Piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 27). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the World Ender can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Charge Eradication Beam (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Octarine energy ripples through the body of the World Ender from its tail up to its head. The World Ender's Eradication Beam recharges, and it chooses the direction it will face to unleash its Eradication Beam. The World Ender can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action it has taken this round. After using this Epic Action, The World Ender can't use Bite, Bellowing Roar, or Devour until the start of the next round.

actions.name: Eradication Beam (Special Recharge)
actions.desc: The World Ender can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action it takes this round. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 27, each creature and object in a 1000-foot long, 20-foot wide Line. Failure: 110 (20d10) Force damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: A creature is disintegrated along with anything it is wearing or carrying if this damage leaves it with 0 Hit Points, and can't be revived except by a [[Tools/Spells/Wish|Wish]] spell. The Eradication Beam destroys any [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|Wall of Force]], [[Tools/Spells/Forcecage|Forcecage]], or [[Tools/Spells/Prismatic Wall|Prismatic Wall]] spell within its area. It also damages unattended magic items in its area, including artifacts.

actions.name: Octarine Lightning Strike
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 27, each creature in a 10-foot radius Sphere centered on a point within 500 feet. Failure: 54 (12d8) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition until the start of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Bellowing Roar (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 27, each creature in a 120-foot Emanation originating from the World Ender that can hear it. Failure: The target has the Deafened condition (save ends). While Deafened, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Ground Slam (1/Round)
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 27, each creature on the ground in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 26 (4d12) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the World Ender and has the Prone condition. Failure or Success: The Cone becomes Difficult Terrain until the start of the World Ender's next turn.

actions.name: Devour
actions.desc: The World Ender can't take this Epic Action if it has used its Bite Epic Action this round. The World ender makes a Bite attack against a Large or smaller creature it has Grappled. If the attack hits, the target takes the Bite's damage, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, it has Total Cover against effects originating from outside the World Ender, and it takes 56 (16d6) Acid damage and gains a Contamination level at the start of each of the World Ender's turns. If the World Ender takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the World Ender must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the World Ender with the Prone condition. If the World Ender dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 30 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The World Ender chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The World Ender can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 125 (7d20 + 49) plus 125 (7d20 + 49) per player character

traits.name: Avoidance
traits.desc: If the Thing with the Writhing Tail is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.desc: The Thing with the Writhing Tail is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the being's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Purring Aura
traits.desc: The Thing with the Writhing Tail projects a 30-foot Emanation of madness and dread. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation has the Frightened condition for 1 hour. A creature can take an action to attempt to overcome its fear, making a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw. Failure: The target takes 27 (5d10) Psychic damage. Success: The Frightened condition ends for that creature, and it becomes immune to the Purring Aura of the Thing with the Writhing Tail for 24 hours.

traits.name: Quantum Displacement
traits.desc: The Thing with the Writhing Tail shifts between realities and timelines. Attack rolls against it have Disadvantage, and it has Advantage on saving throws. If it is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw, this trait is disrupted until it uses Phase Displacement. This trait is also disrupted while the Thing with the Writhing Tail has the Incapacitated condition or a Speed of 0.

actions.name: The Thing with the Writhing Tail always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc: On its turn, The Thing with the Writhing Tail can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, The Thing with the Writhing Tail takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Cosmic Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 10 ft. Hit: 29 (4d10 + 8) Force damage.

actions.name: Tail Whip
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 26, one creature the Thing with the Writhing Tail can see within 30 feet. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: 70 (20d6) Psychic damage, and the target instead has the Stunned condition (save ends). Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Manifest Duplicate (1/Round)
actions.desc: The Thing with the Writhing Tail creates a perfect visual illusion of itself in an unoccupied space it can see within 300 feet. The illusion is intangible and doesn't occupy its space. The duplicate lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if the Thing with the Writhing Tail dismisses it (no action required) or has the Incapacitated condition. The Thing with the Writhing Tail can have a up to eight illusory duplicates at a time. While it has one or more duplicates, it has the following benefits:

actions.name: Attacks and Spells
actions.desc: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can cast spells, use Tail Whip, and make Claw attacks as if was in an illusory duplicate's space.

actions.name: Aura Expansion
actions.desc: Each illusory duplicate emanates a Purring Aura. The effects of multiple overlapping auras do not stack; a creature is only affected once by the Purring Aura even if it is within range of multiple Emanations.

actions.name: Move
actions.desc: Each time the Thing with the Writhing Tail takes this Epic Action, it can move any number of illusions up to 60 feet to unoccupied spaces within 300 feet of itself.

actions.name: Distract
actions.desc: When both the Thing with the Writhing Tail and one of its illusory duplicates are within 10 feet of a creature that can see them, the Thing with the Writhing Tail has Advantage on attack rolls against that creature.

actions.name: Sense
actions.desc: The Thing with the Writhing Tail can see and hear through each of its illusory duplicates.

actions.name: Phase Displacement
actions.desc: The Thing with the Writhing Tail teleports, swapping places with one of its illusory duplicates. If its Quantum Displacement trait was disrupted, it is no longer disrupted.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The Thing with the Writhing Tail chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting it and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Thing with the Writhing Tail can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Psionics; 1/Round)
actions.desc:
The Thing with the Writhing Tail casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 26):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|Detect Thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Beast|Dominate Beast]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|Suggestion]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Evard'S Black Tentacles|Evard's Black Tentacles]], [[Tools/Spells/Dream|Dream]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Invisibility|Greater Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|Major Image]] (level 4 version), [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|Mirror Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Project Image|Project Image]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Sending|Sending]], [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|Telekinesis]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Maze|Maze]], [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|Teleport]]
- **1/Year:** [[Tools/Spells/Gate|Gate]], [[Tools/Spells/Wish|Wish]]

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 100 (8d10 + 56) plus 100 (8d10 + 56) per palyer character

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The Think Tank is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The Think Tank may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Life Support System
traits.desc: The Think Tank is protected by three machine nodes that make up its Life Support System. The nodes are positioned in a triangle, each no further than 30 feet apart from the rest. Each node is a Large object with AC 20, 25 Hit Points per player character, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The Think Tank can't move or be moved more than 60 feet away from any two of its Life Support System nodes.

traits.name: Nightmare Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 120 feet of the Think Tank takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Shield Generator
traits.desc: As long as at least one machine node in the Life Support System remains, the Think Tank's Immunities can't be ignored except by effects caused by level 9 spells or artifacts. If all nodes are destroyed, the Think Tank loses its Immunities.

traits.name: Telepathic Eavesdropping
traits.desc: The Think Tank can project its consciousness to see and hear any creature or location within 5 miles as if it had cast [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]] (no action required). It can read the thoughts of creatures in this area, communicate with them telepathically, and listen in on telepathic communications which occur between other creatures in the region. It remains aware of its own surroundings while doing so. It cannot observe the area within a Private Sanctum spell or locations and creatures protected by magic which blocks divination or scrying sensors.

actions.name: The Think Tank always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On its turn, the Think Tank can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Think Tank takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Contaminated Blast.** Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft., or range 120 ft. Hit: 32 (4d12 + 6) Necrotic damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: The target gains a Contamination level.
- **Telekinetic Grip.** The Think Tank reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 28 (8d6) Force damage, and the target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the Restrained condition until it escapes or the Think Tank has the Incapacitated condition. The Think Tank can hold up to two creatures or objects in its grip at one time. On its turn, a held creature can take an action to repeat the save, escaping the grip on a success. If the target is an object weighing 1,000 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The Think Tank can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating surgical tools or opening a door or a container.
- **Pluck the Puppet Strings.** Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature within 120 feet of the Think Tank. Failure: 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target must use its Reaction to move up to its Speed directly toward a creature of the Think Tank's choice. If the target ends this movement within reach of the chosen creature, it must make a melee weapon attack against that creature with Advantage.

actions.name: Mind Cage (1/Round)
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature the Think Tank can see within 120 feet. Success: 33 (6d10) Psychic damage. Failure: 33 (6d10) Psychic damage, and the target perceives itself to be trapped within a nightmare conjured forth from the depths of its own psyche until it escapes. While trapped, the target has the Immobilized, Blinded, and Deafened conditions. On its turn, the target can take an action to repeat the save. Each time it does, it takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage. On a success, the effect ends for it.

actions.name: Unbind Gravity (1/Round)
actions.desc: The Think Tank controls gravity in a 200-foot Cube centered on itself until the end of the next round. Each time the Think Tank uses this Epic Action, it decides which direction gravity pulls within the area. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall in the chosen direction until they reach the edge of the area. A creature can make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw to grab onto a fixed object it can reach, avoiding the fall on a success. If some solid object (such as a ceiling) is encountered in this fall, falling objects and creatures strike it just as they would during a normal downward fall. If an object or creature reaches the edge of the area without striking anything, it remains there, oscillating slightly, for the duration. Alternatively, the Think Tank can decide to prevent gravity from acting within the area. When it does, creatures within the area without a Fly Speed levitate in midair, and must move by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows them to move as if they were climbing. Unattended objects float around randomly. If the Think Tank doesn't use this Epic Action during the next round, the effect ends and affected objects and creatures fall back down.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The Think Tank chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Think Tank can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

sb.name: Tower Dragon
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
sb.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the dragon remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate bronze statue.

traits.name: Faultless Tracker
traits.desc: The creatures that caused the dragon to animate become its quarries. The dragon knows the direction and distance to its quarries as long the quarries remain within Drakkenheim or until the dragon is destroyed.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The dragon is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The dragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If the dragon is destroyed, it reforms with all of its Hit Points in 1 hour unless a [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|Disintegrate]] spell is cast on its remains.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: + 9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

actions.name: Lightning Breath
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. Failure: 55 (10d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target is pushed up to 40 feet away from the dragon.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The troll hag regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll hag takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the hag's next turn. The troll hag dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll hag makes one Fungal Staff attack and one Slimeball attack. It can replace either attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Fungal Staff
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature within 5ft. Failure: 16 (3d8 + 3) Psychic damage and the target has the Addled condition (save ends).

actions.name: Slimeball
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) Acid damage and the target has the Burning condition (3d10 Acid).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The troll hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|Druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|Bestow Curse]] (Level 5 version), [[Tools/Spells/Plant Growth|Plant Growth]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Contact Other Plane|Contact Other Plane]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]]

bonus_actions.name: Spore Step
bonus_actions.desc: The troll hag magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it.

reactions.name: Spawn Troll
reactions.desc: Trigger: The troll hag takes damage. Response: Create one Fungal Trolling in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the troll hag. The fungal trolling acts immediately after the triggering creature's turn, then after the troll hag's turn on subsequent rounds.

traits.name: Fungal Aura
traits.desc: The ground in a 10-foot radius of any of the three hags is difficult terrain and grants the hags half cover as it is covered in constant fungal growths and clouds of spores unless the hag has the Incapacitated condition. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, any creature who ends its turn within the area. Failure: The target has the Staggered and Bewildered conditions (save ends)

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The troll hag regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll hag takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the hag's next turn. The troll hag dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.desc:
While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks).

- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|Counterspell]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Sickness|Ray of Sickness]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Cloudkill|Cloudkill]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Invisibility|Greater Invisibility]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll hag makes one Fungal Staff attack and one Slimeball attack. It can replace either attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Fungal Staff
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature within 5ft. Failure: 16 (3d8 + 3) Psychic damage and the target has the Addled condition (save ends).

actions.name: Slimeball
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) Acid damage and the target has the Burning condition (3d10 Acid).

actions.name: Garden of Fungal Delights (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The coven pours their strange brew upon the mushroom patches around them, immediately spawning 7 (2d6) Fungal Trollings.

actions.name: Rapid Growth (1/Day)
actions.desc: If all three hags use their action to target the same fungal trolling within 60 feet of them with this ability, that trolling erupts in size and becomes a Humongous Fungus Troll. While the hags are using this ability, they must maintain Concentration. If any of the hags lose Concentration before the third hag takes its action, the ability is not wasted but they must start over. While being targeted by Rapid Growth, the targeted fungal trolling has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Vexing Curse
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 19 (3d10 + 3) Psychic damage and the target has the Jinxed (1d6) condition (save ends).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The troll hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|Druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Bestow Curse|Bestow Curse]] (Level 5 version), [[Tools/Spells/Plant Growth|Plant Growth]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Contact Other Plane|Contact Other Plane]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|Scrying]] The hag may replace either its Fungal Staff or Slimeball attack with the following:

traits.name: Absorbing Flesh
traits.desc: A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by the growth is absorbed into its body and dies. When it absorbs a creature, the growth's size increases by one category. If the growth finishes a Long Rest and hasn't absorbed a body since its last Long Rest, its size decreases by one category.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The growth makes a number of attacks based on its size: two (Medium), three (Large), four (Huge) or five (Gargantuan).

actions.name: Assimilating Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Necrotic damage, and if the target is smaller than the growth, it is subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: The target is swallowed by the growth. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover from attacks and effects outside the growth, and takes 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage and the start of each of the growth's turns. The growth regains Hit Points equal to the amount of Necrotic damage dealt, and excess healing increases its Hit Point Maximum. If the growth takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the growth must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land with the Prone condition in unoccupied spaces within 10 feet of the growth. If the growth dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Adaptable Flesh
reactions.desc: Trigger: The growth takes damage from a spell or attack. Response: The growth halves the damage it takes from the triggering spell or attack.

sb.name: Undulating Polyp
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Displacement
traits.desc: The polyp's form is constantly shifting and moving through reality in unnatural ways. Attack rolls against the polyp have Disadvantage. If the polyp takes damage, this trait ceases to function until the start of its next turn. This trait is suppressed while the polyp has the Incapacitated or Restrained conditions or is otherwise unable to move.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The polyp makes two Mucus attacks.

actions.name: Mucus
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Acid damage, and a 5-foot radius centered on the target is covered in acidic slime for 1 minute. A creature other than the polyp that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 10 (3d6) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (3d6 Acid).

actions.name: Slip Space
actions.desc: The polyp teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the polyp when it reappears. Failure: 16 (3d10) Force damage. Failure by 5 or More: The target triggers an Arcane Anomalies centered on itself. Success: Half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Shift Step
bonus_actions.desc: The polyp teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

reactions.name: Confused Realities
reactions.desc: Trigger: The polyp takes damage from a creature it can see within 30 feet. Response: The triggering creature is teleported to an unoccupied space the polyp can see within 30 feet of its original space. The destination must be on a surface or liquid that can support the target without the target having to squeeze.

traits.name: From Another World
traits.desc: The void pirate doesn't have the standard Aberrant Traits other creatures in the Space Between Worlds have.

traits.name: Keen Eye, Sharp Wit
traits.desc: The void pirate has Advantage on Initiative rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The void pirate makes three attacks.

actions.name: Void Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Pirate Pistol
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Bark Orders
bonus_actions.desc: One void pirate squib or quartermaster within 60 feet of the void pirate can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed or make an attack.

reactions.name: Captain's Command (2/Day)
reactions.desc: Trigger: A Friendly creature within 30 feet of the void pirate fails an attack roll. Response: If the creature can hear the void pirate, it can reroll the attack roll and use the higher result.

traits.name: From Another World
traits.desc: The void pirate doesn't have the standard Aberrant Traits other creatures in the Space Between Worlds have.

traits.name: Magical Chaos
traits.desc: When the void pirate or a creature within 30 feet of it is targeted by a spell, roll a d6. On a 4-5, an Arcane Anomalies triggers on the caster. On a 6, the spell fails and an Arcane Anomalies triggers on the caster.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The void pirate makes three Void Blast attacks.

actions.name: Void Blast
