actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) Force damage, and the target is knocked 10 feet away from the void pirate.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The void pirate casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14, +6 to spell attacks):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (included above), [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|Prestidigitation]]
- **2/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Chromatic Orb|Chromatic Orb]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|Faerie Fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Heat Metal|Heat Metal]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Arcane Eye|Arcane Eye]], [[Tools/Spells/Evard'S Black Tentacles|Evard's Black Tentacles]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|Fly]]

bonus_actions.name: Summon Elemental (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: The void pirate magically summons an Entropic Flame, Walking Geode, Living Deep Haze, or Animated Delerium Sludge. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the void pirate, whom it obeys. It takes its turn immediately after the void pirate. It lasts for 1 hour, until it or the void pirate dies, or the void pirate dismisses it as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Captain's Orders
traits.desc: While within 60 feet of a void pirate captain, the void pirate has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed and Frightened conditions.

traits.name: Duel to the Death
traits.desc: Once per turn, if the Void Pirate is within 5 feet of an enemy, and no other creatures are within 5 feet of them, the void pirate can deal an extra 10 (3d6) Slashing damage with their Voidblade attack.

traits.name: From Another World
traits.desc: The void pirate doesn't have the standard Aberrant Traits other creatures in the Space Between Worlds have.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The void pirate makes two attacks.

actions.name: Voidblade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 4) Force damage.

actions.name: Boltgun
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Bark Orders
bonus_actions.desc: One void pirate squib within 60 feet of the void pirate can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed or make an attack.

traits.name: Captain's Orders
traits.desc: While within 60 feet of a void pirate captain, the void pirate has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed and Frightened conditions.

traits.name: From Another World
traits.desc: The void pirate doesn't have the standard Aberrant Traits other creatures in the Space Between Worlds have.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The void pirate makes two Void Cutlass attacks or uses its Sturdy Net.

actions.name: Void Cutlass
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Sturdy Net
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 15/30 ft. Hit: The target has the Restrained and Defenseless conditions. A creature can take an action to free itself or another creature in a net with a successful DC 14 Strength check. Dealing 10 Slashing damage to the net (AC 12) frees the target without harming it and destroys the net.

bonus_actions.name: Man the Cannons
bonus_actions.desc: The void pirate loads an artillery weapon, such as a cannon or ballista.

sb.name: Walking Delerium Geode
sb.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 10

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.desc: The elemental explodes when it dies and it hasn't taking Force, Radiant, or Thunder damage since its last turn. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the elemental. Failure: 42 (12d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Failure or Success: The explosion triggers a random Arcane Anomalies (see Appendix C).

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.desc: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes two Shard Slam attacks.

actions.name: Shard Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

traits.name: Faultless Tracker
traits.desc: The creature that caused the gargoyle to animate becomes its quarry. The gargoyle knows the direction and distance to its quarry as long the quarry remains within Drakkenheim or until the gargoyle is destroyed.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If the wall gargoyle is destroyed, it reforms with all of its Hit Points in 1 hour unless a [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|Disintegrate]] spell is cast on its remains.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gargoyle makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.desc: The ratling has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Balefire
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Burning condition (2d8 Necrotic).

actions.name: Conjure Swarms (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: The ratling conjures two Swarms of Rats, which appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet. The swarms act immediately after the ratling in Initiative. The swarms remain for 1 minute or until destroyed.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The ratling casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]] (self only; included above), [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|Minor Illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|Thaumaturgy]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Augury|Augury]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|Dispel Magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|Invisibility]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|Major Image]]

bonus_actions.name: Teleport
bonus_actions.desc: The ratling teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The warp marauder is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The warp marauder may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.desc: As an action, the warp marauder can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the warp marauder has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.desc: The warp marauder is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the warp marauder's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Extraplanar Gullet
traits.desc: The warp marauder's back opens into a large mouth that leads to an extradimensional gullet. Anything it swallows is transported into this extraplanar space, which manifests as a rhizomatic network of slurping tunnels and fleshy passages. This space can hold any number of creatures of any size, and nothing inside the space can harm the warp marauder. A creature within the gullet can take an action to attempt to escape, making a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a success, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of the warp marauder. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. If the warp marauder dies, everything inside the extraplanar gullet appears in the nearest unoccupied spaces to its corpse.

traits.name: Grasping Tentacles
traits.desc: The warp marauder can have up to four tentacles at a time. Each tentacle has AC 20, 10 Hit Points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Destroying a tentacle deals no damage to the warp marauder, which can extrude a replacement tentacle on its next turn. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to break a tentacle with a successful DC 15 Strength check.

traits.name: Swirling Color Field
traits.desc: A field of shimmering color reverberates around the warp marauder, distorting reality. A creature that hits the warp marauder with an attack suffers one of the following effects, determined randomly (roll 1d6). A creature Grappled and adjacent to the warp marauder isn't affected by the Swirling Color Field.

traits.name: 1-2: Blue
traits.desc: The attacker is teleported to an unoccupied space the warp marauder can see within 20 feet. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target. The attacker is then subjected to the following effect. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target has the Immobilized condition (save ends).

traits.name: 3-4: Yellow
traits.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 21 (6d6) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

traits.name: 5-6: Red
traits.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target has the Staggered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warp marauder makes four Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes one Bite attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 60 ft. Hit: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and has Disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and the warp marauder can't use this tentacle against another target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft, one creature Grappled by the warp marauder. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing damage, and the warp marauder swallows the target. The target, along with everything it is wearing and carrying, appears in the warp marauder's Extraplanar Gullet.

actions.name: Reel
actions.desc: The warp marauder pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

bonus_actions.name: Dimensional Jump
bonus_actions.desc: The warp marauder teleports to an unoccupied space within 120 feet. Alternatively, it travels from the Material Plane to the Space Between Worlds or vice versa.

reactions.name: Reality Hunter
reactions.desc: Trigger: A creature Grappled by the warp marauder attempts to teleport. Response—Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: 21 (6d6) Force damage, and the teleport fails. Success: The teleport fails, but no resources are wasted.

sb.name: Warp Witch
sb.damage_resistances: acid, bludgeoning, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
sb.languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The warp witch can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Balefire Lantern
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) Cold damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of the warp witch's next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Scream
actions.desc: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Possession
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, one Humanoid the warp witch can see within 5 feet. Failure: The target is possessed by the Warp Witch. The witch disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The witch controls the target's body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The witch can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead. The witch retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions. It otherwise uses the possessed target's game statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points, the witch ends it as a Bonus Action, or the witch is turned or forced out by an effect like the [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Evil And Good|Dispel Evil and Good]] spell. When the possession ends, the witch reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. If the target succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to this warp witch's Possession for 24 hours.

bonus_actions.name: Mutate Host
bonus_actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the warp witch is possessing. Failure: The target gains one Contamination level and a mutation.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.desc: The troll is Immune to the Frozen condition(s).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll makes two Slam attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace its Bite attack with Freezing Breath, if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of the troll's next turn. Critical Hit: The target has the Frozen condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Freezing Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage and has the Frozen condition (escape DC 16). Success: Half damage only.

traits.name: Conditioned Obedience
traits.desc: While the patient can see its creator, it has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

actions.name: Rusty Surgical Blade
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

reactions.name: Protective Impulse
reactions.desc: Trigger: The patient's creator is targeted by an attack or spell, and the patient is within 10 feet of it. Response: The patient switches spaces with its creator and becomes the target instead.

sb.name: Young Delerium Dragon
sb.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 20

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 52 (5d10 + 25) plus 52 (5d10 + 25) per player character

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.desc: The dragon is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The dragon may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.desc: As an action, the dragon can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the dragon has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.desc: The dragon is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the dragon's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the dragon takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: The dragon always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.desc:
On its turn, the dragon can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the dragon takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

- **Bite.** Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) Force damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
- **Contaminated Rend.** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 5 feet of the dragon. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level.
- **Tail.** Strength Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 20 feet of the dragon. Failure: 14 (4d6) Force damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Octarine Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage plus 14 (4d6) Psychic damage plus 14 (4d6) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Dimension Hop (1/Round)
actions.desc: The dragon teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.desc: The dragon chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The dragon can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

actions.name: Mage Hand
actions.desc: The dragon casts [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]] using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The hand created by the spell is invisible.

traits.name: Unshakeable Faith (1/Day)
traits.desc: When the zealot would fail a saving throw, it can reroll the save with Advantage. It must use the new roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The zealot makes two Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: For the Flame (1/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: Allies of the zealot within 60 feet of it that can hear it gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of the zealot's next turn.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.desc: The vampire has Advantage on melee attack rolls against a creature with the Bloodied condition.

traits.name: Blood Shield
traits.desc: Whenever the vampire damages a creature that has blood, the vampire gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.desc: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d4 + 5) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 21).

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. Failure: 15 (3d6 + 5) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point Maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

bonus_actions.name: Morrigan's Fury (1/Short Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: The vampire howls at the moon, gaining Resistance to all damage except Acid and Radiant damage for 1 minute or until it has the Incapacitated condition. As part of this Bonus Action, the vampire moves up to half its Speed toward a Hostile creature without provoking Opportunity Attack action.
